items.text:
Workshop Technician
£28,000 - £30,000 + Training + Days + Flexible Working Hours + Excellent Benefits
Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire (Commutable from: Bedford, Leighton Buzzard, Buckingham, Towcester, Luton)
Are you from a multi skilled engineering background, looking to work for a small but highly successful business offering specialist training and long-term stability & career development?
On offer is an excellent opportunity to take the next step in your career in a highly varied workshop position, where you will be rewarded through fantastic benefits and a great work-life balance.
The company have a great reputation across their loyal client base and are going from strength to strength. With exciting plans for the future, they are now looking to add to their close-knit team.
In this varied role you will be based in their workshop, carrying out the service and repair of their specialist electromechanical equipment. You will be given full training on their machinery.
This role would suit someone from a multiskilled background, with workshop experience, looking for a secure long-term opportunity with plenty of training, development and a great work life balance.
The Role: - Workshop Technician - Service & repair of electromechanical machinery - Monday to Friday, Days (37 ½ hour week + flexible working hours)
The Person: - Hands on electrical and mechanical experience - Background in workshop environment - Commutable to Milton Keynes
Job Reference Number: 281271 To apply for this role or to be considered for further roles, please click "Apply Now" or contact [Jack Banks] at Rise Technical Recruitment.
Rise Technical Recruitment Ltd acts an employment agency for permanent roles and an employment business for temporary roles.
The salary advertised is the bracket available for this position. The actual salary paid will be dependent on your level of experience, qualifications and skill set and will be decided by our client, the employer. Rise are not responsible or liable for any hiring decisions made by the end client.
We are an equal opportunities company and welcome applications from all suitable candidates.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
We are currently recruiting for a Labels Coater / Finishing Operator to join a busy manufacturing operation in Milton Keynes. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced machine operative looking to join a stable business offering long-term career progression.
The Role
As a Labels Coater / Finishing Operator, you will be responsible for operating, monitoring and maintaining coating and rewinding machinery to ensure the production of high-quality label products. You will play a key role in maintaining production efficiency, quality standards and health and safety compliance.
Key Responsibilities
Setting up and operating coating and rewinding machinery
Monitoring machine performance and making adjustments where required
Carrying out routine quality checks and inspections
Recording production data accurately
Performing basic maintenance, cleaning and troubleshooting tasks
Supporting production schedules and continuous improvement initiatives
Loading and unloading materials and ensuring correct stock handling
Maintaining high standards of health, safety and housekeeping
Skills & Experience Required
Previous experience operating coating, slitting, rewinding or similar converting machinery
Alternatively, strong mechanical aptitude with manufacturing experience
Good attention to detail and commitment to quality
Basic numerical skills and the ability to complete production records accurately
Strong communication and teamwork skills
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
Practical approach to maintenance and fault finding
Desirable
Experience within labels, packaging, print finishing or manufacturing environments
Knowledge of manufacturing health and safety procedures
Experience using production systems or digital reporting tools
Relevant machine operating or engineering qualifications/training
Working Hours
This is a full-time permanent position working rotating shifts between 6:00am and 10:00pm.
Salary
£32,000 per annum
We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.

items.text:
Job Title: Warehouse Operative
Location: Milton Keynes
Pay Rate: £12.71 per hour
Shift Pattern: Day shift only
Contract Type: Temporary (Immediate Start)
About the Role
We are looking for enthusiastic and reliable Warehouse Operatives to join our busy team in Milton Keynes on a temporary contract. In this role, you will be working exclusively with books-handling everything from bestselling novels to educational materials-making it a great fit for book lovers and anyone looking for flexible work.
Best of all, this position is day shifts only, meaning no night shifts and a great work-life balance!
Key Responsibilities
* Order Picking: Accurately pick book orders using pick sheets or handheld scanners.
* Packing: Safely pack books into boxes or mailers to ensure they arrive in pristine condition for customers.
* Stock Management: Help with receiving new stock, restocking shelves, and conducting inventory counts.
* Housekeeping: Maintain a clean, safe, and tidy workspace within the warehouse.
What We Are Looking For
* No previous experience needed! Full training will be provided.
* A reliable, hardworking, and punctual attitude.
* Good attention to detail to ensure orders are picked and packed accurately.
* The ability to stand, walk, and handle light-to-moderate lifting throughout your shift.

items.title: Trainee Service Technician
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Our client specialise in the design and implementation of specialist air flow systems. With a range of leading clients across most UK universities, hospitals and biomedical research facilities, they are hugely customer centric and are experiencing a growth phase currently. They are looking for a Trainee Airflow Service Technician to be based in around the Milton Keynes/Northampton area to cover a region of Oxfordshire, Buckinghamshire and Cambridgeshire with flexibility for occassional travel to other parts of England and Ireland. A company van will be provided for this and when the role involves nights away this will be covered by the company. Reporting into the Technical Services team, the Service Technician will provide planned preventive maintenance support, delivering a consistently high quality and accurate service which is driven by an understanding of customers’ needs and expectations. You will recieve best in class training for around four to six months before working on your own within the field.
Service Technician – Responsibilities
- Attend customer sites on allocated date and to agreed time.
- Carry out Planned Preventive Maintenance (and occasional repair) work to the highest technical standard.
- Administration and reporting.
- Collate, gather and communicate feedback with customers and in house teams.
- Work with other team members on installation, commissioning and training projects.
- Ensure all new equipment is installed to the highest possible standard.
- Work in conjunction with the Line Management and Training Manager to identify and action training requirements.
- Participate as a member of the Technical Services team, providing support to other team members where required.
- Put forward ideas and assist in the development of standards and procedures to assist in the overall progression of the department and company.
Service Technician - Desired Skills
- Keen eye for detail and an interest in engineering.
- Hands on skills or experience from any sector, coupled with an interest in problem solving & fixing things.
- Process/procedurally driven and able to offer exceptional levels of customer service.
- Self-motivated with an ability to learn and to work under pressure to high standards
In return for your hard work and technical knowledge our client offers some great benefits including a work Van with fuel card, Pension of 3%, rising to 5.5% after two years that the company contributes to, regular salary review and an annual bonus of 12%. This is a Monday to Friday role, so no weekend or shift work as sites laregly operate 9am-5pm. This would be an ideal role for somebody who has an interest in working with their hands, looking to take on an entry level role where they can progress in time to become a fully qualified engineer. It could also suit somebody who is looking for a career change and a route into an egineering led role. You'll receive amazing on the job training and will have the chance to shadow an engineer for 3-4 months whilst you get a feel for products and the company.
Apply now to be considered for their Airlow Service Technicin role.
#INDMM

items.text:
HR Administrator
Central Milton Keynes | Hybrid Working Salary: Up to £30,000 + Benefits
Are you an organised and detail-focused HR professional looking for your next challenge within a fast-paced, growing business?
We are recruiting on behalf of a successful and expanding organisation for an HR Administrator to join a busy HR team based in Milton Keynes. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous HR experience who thrives in a high-volume environment and enjoys providing outstanding support to employees and stakeholders across the business.
The Role
As HR Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting the entire employee life-cycle, taking ownership of onboarding and off boarding processes while acting as a first point of contact for HR-related queries.
Key responsibilities will include:
Managing the onboarding process from offer stage through to successful completion of probation
Preparing and issuing offer letters, contracts and employment documentation
Coordinating new starter administration and ensuring a smooth employee experience
Managing the leaver process, including exit interviews and HR system updates
Maintaining accurate employee records and ensuring HR data is consistently up to date
Managing a central HR inbox and responding to employee and manager enquiries
Supporting with queries relating to benefits, payroll, holiday entitlement, maternity, paternity and general HR policies
Liaising with stakeholders across the business to provide timely and accurate HR support

- Attend customer sites on allocated date and to agreed time.
- Carry out Planned Preventive Maintenance (and occasional repair) work to the highest technical standard.

items.text:
Hours:
Monday to Friday
2pm to 10pm
Company Overview:
Our Client designs, manufactures and services the packaging solutions that protect the medicines that save lives. Every day, countless treatments need to be transported to those that need them. A single dose may cost over $100,000 and be someone’s last hope of beating a terrible illness. As they travel, by road and air, these medicines need to be kept safe and at very precise temperatures. Their journeys might take them from dry heat in India to frozen conditions in Iceland. It’s our Client’s job to ensure they remain safe, effective and ready to save lives – no matter the conditions.
Our Client is a global market leader in their field, and as the business continues to grow, they are looking for great new talent to join their team.
Job Duties:
Operate production machinery safely and efficiently.
Set up and load machinery as required.
Monitor machines during production and report any issues or faults.
Feed materials and components into machinery.
Carry out quality checks on finished products.
Work quickly and efficiently to achieve daily production targets.
Follow production instructions and processes accurately.
Maintain a clean and organised work area.
Follow all health and safety procedures.
Work as part of a busy production team.
Complete basic paperwork and production records where required.
The Ideal Candidate
Previous machine operating or production experience is desirable.
Wanting a PM on an ongoing basis
Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Able to work to targets and deadlines.
Good attention to detail and quality.
Reliable, punctual and hardworking.
Able to follow instructions and established processes.
Safety-conscious with a good understanding of workplace procedures.
Comfortable carrying out repetitive tasks while maintaining a high standard of work
About the Company:
Our Client’s reputation is based on decades of delivering quality, reliability and innovation. They work with temperature ranges down to -198.5°C and can guarantee temperature stability for 200 hours or more without the need for powered temperature control.
Quality is at the heart of everything they do. Across their production and assembly lines, in their service centres, and among everyone who supports them, attention to detail and high personal standards are essential. It’s about teamwork – everyone playing their part as part of something bigger that makes a difference.
Their people are their biggest asset, and they are passionate about helping everyone fulfil their potential. That’s why they are investing heavily in development and making career progression accessible to all who want it. They offer practical technical skills training alongside core skills development to help employees unlock new opportunities for growth, perhaps even opportunities they hadn't previously considered.
Their commitment to their people has led to them being named in the 2026 Culture Excellence Awards as one of the Top Places to Work for both Employee Wellbeing and Professional Development.
As the business grows, they want their employees to grow too. They offer structured Development Plans to all employees and have created their own School of Cool, a virtual university for core skills, which is available to everyone.
Many people who initially join as temporary workers go on to secure permanent employment, enjoying long-term careers and progressing through multiple roles with increased pay as they develop new skills and experience.

items.text:
What's in it for you
At Booker, along with being a great place to work and giving you an opportunity to get on in your career, we also offer the following fantastic package of benefits:
A Booker colleague card with 10% off purchases at Booker and double discount events up to three times a year.
After 3 months service, a Tesco colleague discount card with 10% increasing to 15% off most purchases at Tesco for a 4 day period after every four-weekly pay day, ie. thirteen times a year. In addition to 10% off at Tesco Cafe and 20% off all F&F purchases.
10% off pay monthly & SIM only deals with Tesco Mobile for yourself, along with further great deals through-out the year.
Up to 30% off car, pet and home insurance at Tesco bank. Terms and conditions apply.
Free eye test when you spend £50 or more. You can also save 30% when you spend £50 or more on glasses, prescription sunglasses and contact lenses.
50% off health checks at Tesco Pharmacy.
Exclusive access to discounted RAC breakdown cover rates
An exclusive deals and discounts website saving you money on everyday purchases including a cycle to work scheme.
After 3 months service, you can join our annual Save As You Earn share scheme which allows you to buy Tesco shares in the future at a discount.
Retirement savings plan (pension) - save up to 5% and Booker will match your contribution.
Life Assurance - You are covered for death in service life cover of up to three times annual pay
Health and Wellbeing support and resources including our 24/7, confidential Employee Assistance Programme and Virtual GP for you and your family.
A great holiday package
About the role
Booker Group are recruiting for a Facilities Assistant to work in our head office in Wellingborough. In this varied and interesting role, you will work within a small and friendly team to support the business. Key duties in this role are picking of items to be sent out to Booker branches, stock management and stock control, as well as supporting a range of facilities related tasks.
This is a physical role which involves being on your feet for much of the day and undertaking manual handling activities, including regular lifting and moving of stock. You will need to be comfortable getting stuck into a variety of tasks as required.
Weekly working hours are 38 per week, Monday to Friday, with a half hour unpaid lunch break each day.
Hours are to be confirmed but will fall within our opening hours of 8.00am to 5.00pm. Flexibility is important as we are a small team and colleagues work together to ensure operational cover across these hours.
You will be responsible for
Picking, packing and dispatch of orders
Stock management and dealing with goods in
Ad hoc duties as required to assist with the wider Facilities Team
You will need
Good knowledge and experience of goods picking and stock management
Practical and reliable with a can-do attitude
To be flexible in your approach and working hours, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team
Good housekeeping and organisational skills
Great customer service skills
Good communication skills
Literacy and numeracy skills
Basic PC skills are essential – we use systems including Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and using our colleague intranet and training systems. Training and guidance will be provided
About The Company
Booker is the UK's leading food & drink wholesaler. We are privileged to serve independent retailers, caterers and small businesses, from locations across the country. We operate over 190 cash and carry branches, eight distribution centres, five Best Food Logistics sites, as well as six support centre locations across the UK.
Diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) at Booker means that whoever you are and whatever your background, we always want you to feel represented and that you can be yourself at work. In short, we’re a place where Everyone’s Welcome.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Booker and Best, we always welcome conversations about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we may be able to support you.
We’re proud that Booker is a Disability Confident Committed employer and we’re committed to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process.
Please note
We can only accept candidates over the age of 18 if the role requires working before 6:15 am or after 9:45 pm or involves working in areas such as the warehouse, beers, wines & spirits, and driving roles.
On the occasions where we have high volumes of applicants, some roles may close earlier than the advertised end date in order for us to manage all of the applicants appropriately. We will only be able to offer individual feedback to those candidates who attend an interview.
*Booker Group is part of Tesco plc, however, is operated separately from the core Tesco business and as such the benefits offered will be different from those offered at Tesco*

The Opportunity
Synergy Plus Recruitment is currently recruiting reliable and motivated Production Operatives to join a busy, established manufacturing operation in Milton Keynes.

If you're hands-on, hardworking and take pride in producing work to a high standard, we'd love to hear from you!
Key Responsibilities
As a Production Operative, your duties will include:
Setting up, operating and monitoring production lines, machinery and conveyor systems to ensure smooth and efficient production.
Packing, sealing, labelling and preparing finished products for dispatch.
Carrying out regular quality checks and accurately recording production data.
Identifying and reporting quality issues, faults and non-conformances.
Maintaining excellent standards of hygiene, cleanliness and housekeeping throughout the production area.
Cleaning machinery and equipment to prevent contamination and maintain production standards.
Carrying out basic machine maintenance and reporting any technical issues.
Following all health and safety, food safety and site procedures.
Working collaboratively with colleagues to maintain productivity, quality and audit-ready standards.
Skills & Experience Required as a Production Operative:
We're looking for candidates who demonstrate:
Previous production or manufacturing experience (desirable but not essential).
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining quality standards.
The ability to follow instructions and work accurately with small components.
Confidence working in a fast-paced, high-volume production environment.
A reliable, punctual and hardworking attitude.
Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
A flexible approach to working a rotating day and night shift pattern.

£16.87 per hour basic pay.
£25.31 per hour overtime rate.
Two 30-minute paid breaks per shift.
Consistent 4 on / 4 off shift pattern.
Ongoing work with genuine temp-to-perm opportunities.
Full training and development.

Opportunities to secure long-term employment and develop your career within a prestigious manufacturing business.

The Role

Work Most of your apprenticeship is spent working. You’ll learn on the job by getting hands-on experience. What you'll do at work This is your chance to gain real experience across the entire engineering lifecycle. As an Electrical, Control and Instrumentation Engineering Apprentice, you’ll rotate through 6-month placements across different areas of our Cavendish Nuclear business. This structure is designed to help you build a well-rounded skillset and explore what excites you most within engineering. You could be designing control systems for nuclear decommissioning, supporting the infrastructure of the UK’s submarine deterrent, or working on the development of cutting-edge facilities for future nuclear fusion reactors. Your week might involve working with PLCs, SCADA systems, reactor protection, or radiological monitoring equipment. Throughout, you’ll be supported by experienced engineers and mentors who will help you develop the confidence, communication and technical skills you need to succeed. This programme offers you a chance to contribute to some of the most important and exciting engineering projects in the country. Where you'll work Leicester LE3 1UF

The ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workload effectively in a busy environment.
A proactive and flexible approach, with a willingness to support the HR Manager and the Management Team.

items.title: Electronics Technician
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Introduction
Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training.
What you will be part of
Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe.
Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems.
Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations.
The Role:
To provide technical support for the assembly, integration, testing, maintenance and repair of electronic and electromechanical systems, ensuring high standards of quality, safety and workmanship are maintained whilst supporting laboratory, development and production activities.
Key Responsibilities:
Manufacture and assemble electronic and electromechanical systems, including wiring harnesses, PCBAs, mechanical assemblies and associated hardware.
Carry out inspection, testing, integration and commissioning of electronic and electromechanical assemblies in accordance with approved procedures and documentation.
Diagnose, troubleshoot and repair faults within electronic, electrical and electromechanical systems.
Support the modification, rework and maintenance of prototype and production hardware to meet engineering and quality requirements.
Interpret engineering drawings, wiring schematics, assembly instructions and test documentation to accurately build and integrate systems.
Assist in the installation, operation and testing of sensors, actuators, motors and other electromechanical devices.
Maintain accurate build, test and inspection records in accordance with company quality processes.
Ensure compliance with ESD, health and safety, quality and laboratory procedures.
Support the maintenance of laboratory equipment, tooling and work areas, ensuring a safe and organised environment.
Contribute to continuous improvement activities to enhance manufacturing quality, efficiency and repeatability.
Support stock control and management of laboratory consumables and components.
Work collaboratively with engineers and senior technicians to support development, integration and test programmes.
Other Duties and Responsibilities
To actively participate in Blue Bear's Performance Management Scheme.
To undertake such other duties and responsibilities as may be reasonably required within the grade and level of the post.
You will be expected to perform different tasks as necessitated by your evolving role within the company and the overall business objectives of the company.
Some travel within the UK may be required.
The above is not an exhaustive list of duties. You will be expected to perform different tasks as necessitated by your evolving role within the company and the overall business objectives of the company.
Qualifications and Skills:
Essential
Experience in the assembly, testing and repair of electronic and electromechanical systems.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, wiring diagrams and assembly documentation.
Practical experience with electronic assembly, soldering and wiring techniques.
Experience using hand tools, workshop equipment and electrical test instruments.
Understanding of fault-finding techniques for electrical, electronic and electromechanical assemblies.
Awareness of ESD controls, quality standards and safe working practices.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality workmanship.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Desirable
IPC certification or equivalent electronics manufacturing qualifications.
Experience within aerospace, defence, autonomous systems or other highly regulated industries.
Knowledge of engineering change control and configuration management processes.
Familiarity with Civil or Military Aviation standards and regulatory requirements.
Experience training or mentoring junior technicians and laboratory personnel.
Experience working to 6S Methodology
Ability to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

Work Most of your apprenticeship is spent working. You’ll learn on the job by getting hands-on experience. What you'll do at work As an Electrical, Control & Instrumentation (EC&I) Apprentice you will gain practical experience across a wide range of engineering activities, supporting the design and development of Electrical, Control and Instrumentation systems used within complex industrial environments. You will get involved in producing electrical drawings and schematics, selecting equipment and instrumentation, developing PLC/DCS control systems, working with industrial networks, preparing technical specifications and calculations, and supporting system testing and commissioning. Alongside experienced engineers, you’ll learn how engineering designs are developed safely and systematically, gaining exposure to areas such as control panels, motors and drives, sensors and instrumentation, functional safety, cybersecurity and engineering standards. The role is primarily office-based design work, supported by practical engineering experience, providing a strong foundation for a career as a professional EC&I engineer. No two projects are the same, giving you the opportunity to think creatively, solve complex challenges, and develop practical engineering solutions that make a real impact. Where you'll work You can select which locations you want to apply for in your application on Find an apprenticeship. This apprenticeship is available in these locations: RUTHERFORD POINT, 44 EATON AVENUE, BUCKSHAW VILLAGE, CHORLEY, PR7 7NA Blencathra House, Queens Dock, Tangier Street, Whitehaven, CA28 7UX

items.text:
Why Greencore?
Following the combination with Bakkavor in January 2026, we're one of the UK's leading creators of convenience food, driven by a simple purpose: to make every day taste better. As a vibrant and fast-moving business, we're proud to employ over 28,000 talented colleagues across 36 manufacturing sites and 21 distribution depots in the UK and the US. Together, we bring delicious food to life. Our products cover every meal occasion from breakfast through to dinner and dessert, with lunch and snacking in between. In FY25, our shared passion helped us achieve combined revenues of approximately £4bn. Our extensive direct to store (DTS) network, with 17 depots across the UK, allows us to deliver fresh and frozen food both our own and from trusted partners to thousands of stores every day, ensuring consumers enjoy the very best, whenever and wherever they shop
Here at Northampton , we operate one of the most impressive facilities in Europe, based across a campus of 5 manufacturing units, and we have a team of around 2,000 colleagues making high quality premium products every day. We are the sole supplier of sandwiches, wraps, rolls and sushi for Marks & Spencer.
Shift Pattern - 4 On 4 off Nights
What you'll be doing
Carrying out fault finding, problem solving and planned and preventative maintenance on plant equipment to maximise equipment reliability and performance
Responding to internal customer needs to maximise production time according to given priorities
Complying with food safety standards and controls to ensure all work is carried out correctly and safely
Completing all necessary documentation ensuring that it is kept accurate and is audit ready
Identify and recommend opportunities for improvements to promote Health & Safety and/or operational efficiency and effectiveness
Maintenance on a range of manufacturing/production/packaging machinery
What we're looking for
People who have experience operating as an engineer, following a completed accredited apprenticeship or equivalent experience with appropriate Level 3 qualification.
As one of our maintenance engineers you will
Be an apprentice trained engineer with a relevant qualification
Have experience working as a Maintenance Engineer within manufacturing/FMCG or similar
Utilise a proactive approach, with a willingness to learn and develop
Have experience in electrical and mechanical fault finding
At Greencore we put our people at the core. We celebrate their differences and help everyone to be themselves at work. Together we make every day taste better. If this sounds like you join us, grow with Greencore and be a part of driving our future success.
What You'll Get in Return
Competitive salary and job-related benefits
Holidays
Competitive matched pension contributions
Life insurance up to 4x salary
Company share save scheme
Greencore Qualifications
Exclusive Greencore employee discount platform
Access to a full Wellbeing Centre platform
Enhanced parental leave and menopause policies
Throughout your time at Greencore, you will be supported with on the job training and development opportunities to further your career.
We reserve the right to close this advertisement before the stated closing date
Recruitment Fraud Warning: Greencore and its recruitment partners never charge candidates any fees at any stage of the hiring process. Any request for payment relating to a job opportunity should be considered fraudulent.

items.text:
The Permanent Division of Robert Half is recruiting or an Admin and Accounts Assistant on behalf of an Exciting Finance Organisation with offices in Northampton.
The Role
As Admin and Accounts Assistant you will provide assurance that all documents completed for the firm's direct (own book) lending as well as for brokered asset finance agreements are prepared correctly, in line with lender requirements and are complete and accurate. You will also provide expert timely and insightful sales reporting, analysis and other support to the wider Finance team. Day to day duties will consist of:
Verify the completeness and accuracy of finance agreements and supporting documentation packs.
Completion of process checklists to ensure the compliance with all requirements prior to payout (own book lending transactions) or prior to lender submission (brokered asset finance transactions).
Completion of recorded telephone calls with customers for verification purposes, prior to payout.
Updating the CRM system with accurate data and information relevant to the payouts process.
Scanning and filing of agreement packs, including submission of broker payout packs to lenders.
Supporting as required with the maintenance of accurate data within the system used for own book lending finance agreements.
Support with recording of sales data, accurately and efficiently, giving senior management a real-time view of current performance.
Build up a knowledge of various lender commission policies, in order to verify the accuracy of sales data/income transactions.
Record data, accurately and efficiently, on the CRM system to provide necessary information to the sales team and senior management, acting as a gatekeeper for the final process step of activating finance agreements.
Support with other accounting tasks which may include raising invoices, processing supplier invoices, preparation of supplier payment runs, processing employees expenses process.
Participate in internal meetings as required including team meetings and events.
Gather and analyse trends within the organisation's finances.
Develop internal documentation and processes where required, striving to implement or improve processes and internal controls within the finance function.
Your Profile
This is an excellent role for someone with a keen eye for detail and accuracy and working in an Admin or Accounts role currently looking for an opportunity to advance your career in an exciting growth business. The business is high performing and will continue to grow quickly over the next few years.
Salary and Benefits
Role of Admin and Accounts Assistant is based in the office 5 days a week in Northampton and offering a salary of £28-30K + Excellent Benefits
Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training. If you wish to apply, please read our Privacy Notice describing how we may process, disclose and store your personal data:

items.text:
What's in it for you
At Booker, along with being a great place to work and giving you an opportunity to get on in your career, we also offer the following fantastic package of benefits:
A Booker colleague card with 10% off purchases at Booker and double discount events up to three times a year.
After 3 months service, a Tesco colleague discount card with 10% increasing to 15% off most purchases at Tesco for a 4 day period after every four-weekly pay day, ie. thirteen times a year. In addition to 10% off at Tesco Cafe and 20% off all F&F purchases.
10% off pay monthly & SIM only deals with Tesco Mobile for yourself, along with further great deals through-out the year.
Up to 30% off car, pet and home insurance at Tesco bank. Terms and conditions apply.
Free eye test when you spend £50 or more. You can also save 30% when you spend £50 or more on glasses, prescription sunglasses and contact lenses.
50% off health checks at Tesco Pharmacy.
Exclusive access to discounted RAC breakdown cover rates
An exclusive deals and discounts website saving you money on everyday purchases including a cycle to work scheme.
After 3 months service, you can join our annual Save As You Earn share scheme which allows you to buy Tesco shares in the future at a discount.
Retirement savings plan (pension) - save up to 5% and Booker will match your contribution.
Life Assurance - You are covered for death in service life cover of up to three times annual pay
Health and Wellbeing support and resources including our 24/7, confidential Employee Assistance Programme and Virtual GP for you and your family.
A great holiday package
About the role
*This is a Part Time position.
We are looking for someone with a real can-do attitude who is passionate about delivering excellent customer service and willing to go the extra mile for our customers. Working as part of a team you will be working in a dynamic, fast paced environment where no two days are the same.
We are 5/7 day operation, (check our website for specific opening times.)
We only recruit individuals who are aged 17 and over
You will be responsible for
Customers are at the heart of everything we do, our customers need to be back in their own business as quickly as possible having found what they need, we keep the shelves full, provide speed of service through the tills and wish them a fond farewell or maybe our customers need a delivery and we are accurately picking what they need.
You will need
Ideally experience within the Wholesale or Retail environment
A can do attitude A passion for customer service Be willing to go the extra mile Always be there, on time and properly presented.
About The Company
Booker is the UK's leading food & drink wholesaler. We are privileged to serve independent retailers, caterers and small businesses, from locations across the country. We operate over 190 cash and carry branches, eight distribution centres, five Best Food Logistics sites, as well as six support centre locations across the UK.
Diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) at Booker means that whoever you are and whatever your background, we always want you to feel represented and that you can be yourself at work. In short, we’re a place where Everyone’s Welcome.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Booker and Best, we always welcome conversations about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we may be able to support you.
We’re proud that Booker is a Disability Confident Committed employer and we’re committed to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process.
Please note
We can only accept candidates over the age of 18 if the role requires working before 6:15 am or after 9:45 pm or involves working in areas such as the warehouse, beers, wines & spirits, and driving roles.
On the occasions where we have high volumes of applicants, some roles may close earlier than the advertised end date in order for us to manage all of the applicants appropriately. We will only be able to offer individual feedback to those candidates who attend an interview.
*Booker Group is part of Tesco plc, however, is operated separately from the core Tesco business and as such the benefits offered will be different from those offered at Tesco*

Join Our Team at Smurfit Westrock!
Are you searching for a workplace that values you and your growth? At Smurfit Westrock, we’re committed to sustainability, employee well-being, and personal development.
About Us
We are a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging. Our focus is on the health and safety of our employees, the well-being of our communities, and delivering exceptional service to our customers. We support our team members to reach their full potential in an inclusive environment that values diversity.
The Role
An opportunity has arisen for Operatives to join the Production Team, working a 3-shift rotating pattern. We are looking for a highly motivated, focused and driven individual who can demonstrate a positive can-do attitude together with excellent organisation skills. It is expected that the successful applicant will be a strong communicator with ability to support continuous drive for increased production output and reduced wastage.
Previous experience within a manufacturing process operation is preferred, but full training will be provided. It is expected that Production Operatives will be able to train in multiple areas providing a multi skilled and flexible team.
The shift pattern consists of: Week One - 2pm to 10pm, Week Two - 6am to 2pm and Week Three - 10pm to 6am.
The key responsibilities will include:
Operating machines within production
General manual handling
Basic computer tasks
Understanding as well as appreciation of both Health & Safety and Quality
The ideal candidate will be:
Minimum Grade 4 (or equivalent) in English and Maths
Able to prioritise workload to achieve deadlines
A good team player able to work as part of a crew and on their own
Self-motivated
Have good attention to detail
Good communication skills both written and verbal

Competitive salary & benefits, including annual leave, pension, and a Cycle to Work scheme
Ongoing training and development opportunities
24/7 confidential support for you and your family
Flexible working options and family-friendly policies
Guaranteed interview for candidates meeting essential criteria (Disability Confident Employer)
Ready to make an impact? Apply today and help us build a sustainable future together.

items.title: Transport Administrator
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Do you have strong administration skills and enjoy working in a fast-paced transport environment? Are you confident managing delivery schedules, keeping systems and spreadsheets up to date and communicating with drivers, customers and colleagues? Do you enjoy solving problems and helping to keep deliveries running smoothly? Then we have the role for you!
Here at GXO, a fantastic opportunity has arisen for a Transport Administrator to join our team in Milton Keynes , working in partnership with our prestigious customer, LVMH.
You will be working on a full-time , 18-months fixed-term contract, Monday to Friday , on rotating shifts, covering the hours of 06:00 to 14:00 and 14:00 to 22:00.
Pay, benefits and more:
An annual salary of £30,293.00
Holiday pay and a workplace pension
A 24/7 online GP service, life assurance and a fully comprehensive employee assistance programme
Access to our MyBenefits platform offering a variety of high street discounts, cashback cards, a saving scheme and much more!
Access to GXO University – home to a wealth of online training courses, meaning your development never ends!
What you’ll do on a typical day:
Complete delivery schedules and bookings, communicating with the customer on a daily basis
Produce and maintain daily, weekly and monthly KPI data, escalating any issues to the Transport Manager where required
Keep transport systems, spreadsheets and order information accurate and up to date, ensuring administration is completed to a high standard
Manage a busy workload in a fast-paced transport environment, working closely with customers, drivers and colleagues to resolve issues and keep deliveries running smoothly
What you need to succeed at GXO:
Strong IT skills, including experience using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
Excellent communication, customer service and organisational skills, with a friendly and professional approach
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to prioritise a demanding workload, meet tight deadlines and work effectively under pressure
Previous transport industry knowledge would be an advantage, including basic knowledge of tachographs, driver downloads and infringements
We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.
GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. GXO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate, support and thrive on diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe that diversity and inclusion in our business is critical to our success as a global company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. We are an Armed Forces friendly organisation and Disability Confident Leader as part of the Disability Confident Scheme (GIS) and actively welcome applications from people with disabilities.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement

items.text:
Shift pattern: Thurs to Mon/ Sun to Thurs/ Tue to Sat, 20:00- 04:30
Pay Rate £17.29 p/hr
Unit : ABC
Location: Northampton NN3 6RX
Why Greencore?
Following the combination with Bakkavor in January 2026, we're one of the UK's leading creators of convenience food, driven by a simple purpose: to make every day taste better. As a vibrant and fast-moving business, we're proud to employ over 28,000 talented colleagues across 36 manufacturing sites and 21 distribution depots in the UK and the US. Together, we bring delicious food to life. Our products cover every meal occasion from breakfast through to dinner and dessert, with lunch and snacking in between. In FY25, our shared passion helped us achieve combined revenues of approximately £4bn. Our extensive direct to store (DTS) network, with 17 depots across the UK, allows us to deliver fresh and frozen food both our own and from trusted partners to thousands of stores every day, ensuring consumers enjoy the very best, whenever and wherever they shop.
Here at Northampton , we operate one of the most impressive facilities in Europe, based across a campus of 5 manufacturing units, and we have a team of around 2,000 colleagues making high quality premium products every day . We are the sole supplier of sandwiches, wraps, rolls and sushi for Marks & Spencer.
What you'll be doing
Carry out all required quality checks at specified intervals (every 30 minutes/hour), ensuring that any quality or food safety concerns are reported immediately to the Team Leader.
Ensure that all products and production lines meet the required visual standards and specifications.
Maintain high standards of product quality, presentation and finish throughout the production process.
Follow all relevant compliance requirements, risk assessments and Safe Systems of Work (SSOW) to maintain a safe working environment for yourself and colleagues.
Participate in product trials and pre- and post-launch activities, ensuring that quality remains a key priority throughout.
Conduct product sampling, testing, audits and process monitoring to verify that all products and manufacturing processes meet required quality, food safety and compliance standards.
Collect and handle all required product samples in accordance with established procedures and protocols, ensuring product quality, safety and legality.
What we're looking for
GCSEs or equivalent qualifications in English and Mathematics, or equivalent levels of literacy and numeracy.
A good understanding of workplace Health & Safety requirements and the ability to demonstrate safe working practices.
Knowledge and understanding of Health & Safety and Food Hygiene practices.
CCP training, including an understanding of HACCP principles within a manufacturing environment.
Awareness of allergen management and microbiological standards.
Strong attention to detail, with a high level of accuracy and the ability to identify potential quality issues.
Previous experience or knowledge of working within an FMCG manufacturing or warehouse environment would be advantageous.
Willingness to undertake training and develop the skills required to fulfil the Machine Minder role.
At Greencore we put our people at the core. We celebrate their differences and help everyone to be themselves at work. Together we make every day taste better. If this sounds like you, join us and grow with Greencore, and be a part of driving our future success. Throughout your time at Greencore, you will be supported with on the job training and development opportunities to further your career.
What you'll get in return:
Competitive salary and job-related benefits
Holidays
Competitive matched pension contributions
Life insurance up to 4x salary
Company share save scheme
Greencore Qualifications
Exclusive Greencore employee discount platform
Access to a full Wellbeing Centre platform
Free car parking
Enhanced parental leave and menopausal policies
Please note that we reserve the right to withdraw the vacancy at any time, including before the advertised closing date.
Greencore and its recruitment partners never charge candidates any fees at any stage of the hiring process. Any request for payment relating to a job opportunity should be considered fraudulent.

Work Most of your apprenticeship is spent working. You’ll learn on the job by getting hands-on experience. What you'll do at work What You'll Do. Step into the world of advanced manufacturing and learn how precision-engineered components are created for industries that demand the highest standards, including aerospace, defence and marine engineering. As a Machining Technician Apprentice, you'll gain hands-on experience in a professional engineering environment, working with cutting-edge CNC technology and experienced engineers who will support your development every step of the way. If you're practical, curious about how things are made, and ready to turn your passion for engineering into a rewarding career, this apprenticeship offers an exciting opportunity to learn from the best and become a skilled precision engineer. During your apprenticeship, you will: Learn how to read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances and specifications Gain practical experience operating CNC milling machines and lathes used to manufacture high-precision components Prepare tools, materials and machine set-ups while learning industry-standard machining techniques Develop skills in CNC programming, machine setting and process optimisation as your knowledge and confidence grow Inspect components using precision measuring equipment, including micrometers, verniers and gauges, ensuring every part meets exacting quality standards Support the production of components used in critical engineering applications across multiple sectors Learn finishing, deburring and quality control techniques to produce parts to a professional standard Work closely with experienced machinists, programmers and inspectors, gaining valuable insight into the full manufacturing process Follow health, safety and quality procedures while developing excellent workshop practices Attend college training, complete coursework and build a portfolio of evidence towards your apprenticeship qualification We're looking for someone with a genuine interest in engineering, machinery and how things are made, along with good attention to detail and a careful, practical approach to work. You should be reliable, committed to learning, and willing to develop your technical, numeracy and IT skills. The ideal candidate will be able to follow instructions, communicate effectively, work well as part of a team, and demonstrate a strong commitment to safe working practices and completing their college studies. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled Production Operative looking to join a growing business offering long-term stability, career development and a competitive salary.
The successful Production Operative will be responsible for operating production machinery, monitoring manufacturing processes and ensuring products are manufactured to the highest quality standards. The company is looking for a reliable and hardworking individual who can work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Are you looking for a stable, secure warehousing job that will give you a genuine platform to build a career in logistics? If so, read on – we have the perfect opportunity for you!
Here at GXO Northampton we are recruiting for a Warehouse Operative to join our team. Working at our equipment management site, where it’s all about recycling & reuse, for one of the largest supermarket retailers in the UK. You'll play a key role in a busy recycling centre, handling cardboard, plastic, and food waste, as well as supporting the efficient operation of the tray wash process.

Load empty trays and buckets onto the wash machine ready for cleaning

Other warehouse duties depending on operations needs

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
What's in it for you
At Booker, along with being a great place to work and giving you an opportunity to get on in your career, we also offer the following fantastic package of benefits:
A Booker colleague card with 10% off purchases at Booker and double discount events up to three times a year.
After 3 months service, a Tesco colleague discount card with 10% increasing to 15% off most purchases at Tesco for a 4 day period after every four-weekly pay day, ie. thirteen times a year. In addition to 10% off at Tesco Cafe and 20% off all F&F purchases.
10% off pay monthly & SIM only deals with Tesco Mobile for yourself, along with further great deals through-out the year.
Up to 30% off car, pet and home insurance at Tesco bank. Terms and conditions apply.
Free eye test when you spend £50 or more. You can also save 30% when you spend £50 or more on glasses, prescription sunglasses and contact lenses.
50% off health checks at Tesco Pharmacy.
Exclusive access to discounted RAC breakdown cover rates
An exclusive deals and discounts website saving you money on everyday purchases including a cycle to work scheme.
After 3 months service, you can join our annual Save As You Earn share scheme which allows you to buy Tesco shares in the future at a discount.
Retirement savings plan (pension) - save up to 5% and Booker will match your contribution.
Life Assurance - You are covered for death in service life cover of up to three times annual pay
Health and Wellbeing support and resources including our 24/7, confidential Employee Assistance Programme and Virtual GP for you and your family.
A great holiday package
About the role
We are currently recruiting for Warehouse Operatives to join us in our Wellingborough site.
Working in our distribution centres mean fast paced environments, excellent attention to detail with the ability to think quickly and work as part of a team to ensure orders are picked accurately and on time with seamless delivery to our customers.
This role is working any 5 days from 7, PM shifts 2pm -10pm .
**Prior to employment, you must successfully complete a drug and alcohol test**
You will be responsible for
Picking and packing customers orders, using a hand held terminal to understand pick expectation
Receiving storing and stacking appropriately
Working with the best integrity to fulfil all stock requirements and needs
Maintaining a clean and safe environment with health, safe, legal always top of mind
We have LLOP's and FLT's in operation on our sites, and successful individuals will be given the opportunity to be trained on these in certain areas of the DC's.
Our distribution centres typically have ambient, chilled and freezer sections, preferences will be discussed within the process in more detail.
You will need
As a warehouse operative, being flexible and adaptable in a fast-paced environment is essential.
You should be hardworking, able to work to set deadlines, and have a professional, positive, organised, and enthusiastic approach.
While proven experience in a warehouse environment would be preferred, it is not essential.
You should be able to work as part of a team and on your own initiative. Remember, the key to success is being self-motivated.
About The Company
Booker is the UK's leading food & drink wholesaler. We are privileged to serve independent retailers, caterers and small businesses, from locations across the country. We operate over 190 cash and carry branches, eight distribution centres, five Best Food Logistics sites, as well as six support centre locations across the UK.
Diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) at Booker means that whoever you are and whatever your background, we always want you to feel represented and that you can be yourself at work. In short, we’re a place where Everyone’s Welcome.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Booker and Best, we always welcome conversations about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we may be able to support you.
We’re proud that Booker is a Disability Confident Committed employer and we’re committed to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process.
Please note
We can only accept candidates over the age of 18 if the role requires working before 6:15 am or after 9:45 pm or involves working in areas such as the warehouse, beers, wines & spirits, and driving roles.
On the occasions where we have high volumes of applicants, some roles may close earlier than the advertised end date in order for us to manage all of the applicants appropriately. We will only be able to offer individual feedback to those candidates who attend an interview.
*Booker Group is part of Tesco plc, however, is operated separately from the core Tesco business and as such the benefits offered will be different from those offered at Tesco*

items.title: Payroll Administrator
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
We have a fantastic opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to join our growing team in Milton Keynes, you will play a key role in the payroll team by supporting the team leader with day to day duties as well as responding to inquiries from the wider business.
Benefits of working as a Payroll Administrator:
Aviva Digicare + workplace / Car leasing and cycle to work scheme
Colleague discount scheme / Perks at work / Gym discounts
Life assurance / Workplace pension scheme
Key Responsibilities:
Accurately enter data including starters, leavers and change of details.
Actively chase employees for missing paperwork/outstanding information to ensure that cut offs are met.
Prepare audit report daily to allow a team leader/manager to check your work.
Correspond with employees applying for other types of statutory leave, ensuring their understanding and that all legislative requirements have been met.
Accurately input variable data when the pay-run is open including commissions, bonuses and overtime in line with the monthly timetable.
Undertake full checks of the commissions – ensuring they are accurate and complete prior to the monthly cut off.
Process attachment of earnings
Answer general payroll queries by telephone, email and/or letter in a polite, professional and timely fashion.
Required Skills, Knowledge & Experience
Highly Organised
Good telephone skills
Excellent attention to detail
Ability to communicate clearly with employees and team members
Team player, keen to work together and take part in discussions
Be actively interested in the full payroll process
Eager to expand your knowledge or suggest improvements to processes where you can
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (excel/outlook/word)
Able to work under pressure and to strict deadlines
About us
Connells Group is one of the largest and most successful estate agency and property services providers in the UK. Founded in 1936 and with a network of nearly 1200 branches nationwide, the Group combines residential sales and lettings expertise with a range of consumer and corporate services including new homes, mortgage services, conveyancing, EPC provision, surveying, corporate lettings, asset management, land & planning, LPA receivers and auctions.
Connells Group UK is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of ***, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, transgender status, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Connells Group, the Home of Opportunity , is looking for a highly organised and motivated Sales Administrator to join our successful William H Brown residential sales team , based in Northampton .
A quick look at the role
As Sales Administrator, you'll play an important role in supporting the smooth running of our sales office, providing essential administrative support to the team and helping us deliver an excellent experience for our customers.
Your responsibilities will include uploading property details onto various property portals, handling customer enquiries both in branch and over the telephone, maintaining accurate records and supporting the day-to-day administration of the business.
You'll be someone who enjoys keeping things organised, takes pride in getting the details right and is always happy to get involved and support the wider team.
What's in it for you?
Industry-leading training and development
A clear career ladder with opportunities for progression
A supportive, rewarding and fun working environment
Team incentives and recognition
The opportunity to develop your knowledge of the property industry
Skills and experience required
Customer-focused, with a friendly and professional approach
Resilient, positive and able to use your own initiative
Numerate, with good attention to detail and accuracy
Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise a varied workload in a fast-paced environment
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
IT literate, with experience using Microsoft Office, email and internet systems
Previous experience in administration or customer service would be beneficial, but it's not essential. We're just as interested in finding someone with the right attitude, enthusiasm and willingness to learn.
Our Commitment to Inclusion
Connells Group is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of ***, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity status.
If you're excited about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. Potential matters just as much as experience, and you could be the right fit for this role or another opportunity within Connells Group.
Join Connells Group – the Home of Opportunity – and build a successful career with pathways into Sales, Lettings, Mortgage Services, Land, New Homes and other specialist services, within one of the UK's leading property groups.
EA09224

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Business Support Administrator
Salary: £25, 877.80 per annum
Contract: Permanent Location: Bedford Hours: Monday to Friday on a rotating shift pattern Shift pattern: 7:30am to 3:30pm (7:30am to 3:00pm on Fridays) 9:00am to 5:00pm (9:00am to 4:30pm on Fridays) As part of providing office cover throughout the working day, you'll be required to work both shifts above on a rota basis.
Are you an organised, customer-focused professional who enjoys supporting colleagues and creating a positive workplace experience? We're looking for a proactive Business Support Administrator to join our team and play a key role in keeping our office and business support services running smoothly. This is a varied role where no two days are the same. You'll provide business and facilities support across the organisation, helping to deliver an excellent service to colleagues, visitors and customers.
As a Business Support Administrator, you will be:
· Managing incoming and outgoing correspondence, ensuring it is processed accurately and within agreed timescales.
· Preparing meeting rooms and ensuring office facilities, kitchen areas and refreshments are maintained to a high standard.
· Responding to business support and facilities requests, helping to resolve issues efficiently and effectively.
· Supporting central purchasing activities, including raising purchase orders, processing invoices, liaising with suppliers and maintaining stock levels of office supplies.
Acting as the first point of contact for visitors, colleagues and deliveries attending the office.
· Maintaining accurate document management and archiving records, including supporting Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs).
· Working collaboratively with colleagues to provide an efficient and customer-focused service across the business.
What we're looking for:
· A strong team player who enjoys working collaboratively and supporting colleagues to achieve shared goals.
· Customer focused, with a commitment to delivering an exceptional service experience.
· Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities effectively.
· Adaptable and flexible, with a positive can-do attitude and willingness to take on a variety of responsibilities.
· An excellent communicator with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive working relationships.
· Comfortable working independently while also contributing as part of a wider team.
· Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach.
· Confident using Microsoft Office applications and other IT systems.
· GCSE English and Maths (Grade C/4 or above), or equivalent.
· Flexible, adaptable, and willing to take on a variety of tasks-including some lifting and moving of office equipment.
· Previous experience in a customer-focused office support or administrative role.
· Experience of working within a team environment to achieve shared objectives.
Working Arrangements
This role is primarily office-based due to the nature of the service provided. Following successful completion of probation, there may be opportunities for some home working; however, this will always be dependent on service requirements and business needs.
Why join us?
At bpha, our values are at the heart of everything we do. We take responsibility, show empathy, work better together and are ambitious about delivering excellent services for our customers and colleagues. If you're looking for a varied and rewarding role where you can make a real difference as part of a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.
A quick note Even if you don't meet every requirement listed, we'd still love to hear from you if you're enthusiastic, eager to learn and believe you'd be a great fit for the role.
bpha reserves the right to close applications before the advertised closing date, therefore early applications are encouraged.
All offers will be subject to satisfactory pre-employment screening, including DBS check and references.

items.title: Buying Administrator
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Do you thrive on organisation, love keeping things running smoothly, and enjoy working in a fast-paced commercial environment? We're looking for a Buying Administrator to join our Buying team and play a key role in bringing great products to our customers across the British Heart Foundation.
As Buying Administrator, you'll provide essential support throughout the product journey, from selection and ordering through to launch and trade, you will be responsible for the day-to-day administration for the Buying team.
You'll maintain accurate product information, coordinate samples, support supplier communications, and help keep critical deadlines on track. This role will work closely with Buyers, suppliers, and colleagues across Merchandising, Online Trading and Retail, helping to ensure our product ranges are delivered efficiently and effectively.
This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who wants to develop a career within a commercial buying environment.
About you
We're looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive and detail-focused, with a natural ability to manage multiple priorities.
You may already have experience in a retail head office environment or bring strong administrative experience from another fast-paced commercial setting. An interest in buying, products and retail is key.
To succeed in the role, you’ll bring:
Excellent organisational skills.
Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
Good commercial awareness and curiosity about products and retail trends.
Confidence using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and the ability to quickly learn new systems.
Strong communication skills, with the confidence to liaise with suppliers and stakeholders at all levels.
A proactive mindset, always looking for ways to improve processes and ways of working.
The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and meet competing deadlines.
Working arrangements
This role is a hybrid role, where your work will be split between your home and at least one day per week, on average, in our Northampton office. This may vary from time to time, so you will need to work in a flexible way to unlock your best work for our cause. The role also includes occasional travel within the UK to support supplier and business requirements.
Interview process
Interview will be held via MS Teams and will take place week commencing 30th of November.
Belonging at BHF
BHF values the diversity of our communities and is committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and valued. By fostering a culture of inclusion, we believe we are better equipped to achieve our mission of helping people have a healthier heart for longer.
To hear from our people, check out Belonging at BHF.
Benefits and development
We offer a competitive range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing, and opportunities for personal and professional growth and continuous learning. To find out more about our benefits you can download the Benefits document at the bottom of this page or check out our Benefits and Development pages.
Need more help balancing your work and home life? Talk to us about what flexibility is available at the application or interview stage.
How to apply
It’s quick and easy to apply for a role at the BHF. Just click on the apply button below. All you’ll need is an up-to-date CV and to answer a couple of application question.
Our recruitment processes are fair, accessible, and inclusive. BHF use anonymous CV software as part of the application journey.
We support responsible use of AI to help shape your application. By applying for a role at BHF, you confirm that your application is authentic and reflects your own skills and experience, to ensure everyone is assessed fairly.
Should you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please Contact us.

Every day is different within the Service department. As a Service Technician/Mechanic apprentice, some of your duties will include: Use of diagnostic equipment to identify vehicle faults. We are looking for people who are passionate about our industry and our brand. items.text:
SmartPA, the leading expert in virtual admin and PA services, is offering a proven franchise opportunity that allows you to run your own business with expert backing every step of the way.
SmartPA Franchise Partners support their clients by remotely delivering a range of admin and business support solutions. Some will act as a virtual PA, while others may offer additional skills such as HR, finance or social media management.
Offering CPD-accredited training, marketing, and ongoing support, our tried and tested franchise gives you flexibility, predictable income, and the tools to succeed. With a SmartPA franchise, you can turn your ambition into a thriving business, work from home, gain clients from day one, and enjoy the freedom of being your own boss.
About SmartPA
SmartPA has been helping over 3,000 businesses worldwide handle their business and admin tasks efficiently and cost-effectively since 2008.
SmartPA’s franchise model has been tried and tested successfully around the world, with over 100 partners already thriving.
Full-time Franchise Partners typically earn between £60,000 and £70,000 per year, with some exceeding £120,000, while part-time Franchise Partners earn between £30,000 and £50,000. SmartPA provides opportunities for Franchise Partners to work directly with HQ, servicing trusted clients from SME to Corporate and this reliable stream helps to achieve consistent income right from the start. In addition, SmartPA has built a proven insourcing model that allows you to service other Franchise Partners’ clients on a regular basis. This steady flow of work provides stability, predictable income, and the opportunity to expand your business further.
Who are we looking for?
SmartPA Franchise Partners come from a variety of backgrounds. No prior experience is required, what matters most is a positive attitude and the drive to succeed.. SmartPA will provide all the brand, tools, and guidance you need to build a successful business..
Why invest in a SmartPA Franchise?
Low investment: Launch for just £9,950 + VAT
High earning potential:
Full-time franchisees typically earn £60k-£70k per year (some exceed £120k)
Part-time franchisees typically earn £30k-£50k per year
Flexibility: Work from home or anywhere of your choice, choose your hours, and balance your career with life commitments.
Global network: Join a thriving community of 100+ SmartPA franchisees worldwide.
What You’ll Get
Business-in-a-box: Everything you need to launch and run your business.
Guaranteed support.
Secured income: working directly with SmartPA HQ servicing trusted SMEs and corporates.
Insourcing model: Earn additional income by supporting HQ clients and other Franchise Partner’s clients.
Training and mentoring: World-class CPD-accredited training, ongoing mentorship, and continuous professional development.
Marketing and branding: A globally recognised brand with sales and marketing support included.
Technology and IT: Access to SmartPA’s innovative systems and dedicated tech support.
Take the first steps today
If you want to work from anywhere, run your own business, and provide admin and PA services, then SmartPA's Franchise opportunity is perfect for you. Be your own boss today - enquire now and start your own SmartPA venture.

Work Most of your apprenticeship is spent working. You’ll learn on the job by getting hands-on experience. What you'll do at work As one of the world's most advanced technology-driven companies, we're powered by automation, robotics, and continuous innovation - from robotic arms to complex conveyor networks and smart sensor technology that keep millions of customer orders moving. This apprenticeship gives you the chance to become a multi-skilled maintenance technician across both electrical and mechanical disciplines, with hands-on experience on industry-leading equipment, some of which only exists at Amazon. Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is fundamental to our operations - they keep vital machinery running around the clock. As an RME Mechatronics Apprentice, you'll help maintain a wide range of equipment while upholding Health and Safety best practice, keeping your colleagues safe, preventing downtime, and improving the availability and quality of our equipment. You'll thrive here if you stay calm when things go wrong and get a real kick out of fixing them. You're hands-on, curious about how machines work, and you understand that keeping production moving is what it's all about. And you don't need to be a qualified engineer to start - what matters most is a practical, problem-solving mindset and a hunger to learn. A day in the life can involve: Carrying out proactive and preventative maintenance Carrying out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse Using the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness Making modifications and upgrades to existing equipment Upholding health and safety policies and practices Working on continuous improvement projects, and suggesting long-term improvements Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll build a broad, in-demand engineering skillset, including: Fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance Mechanical device maintenance, and fluid power systems assembly and testing Electrical equipment wiring and testing Hydraulics and pneumatics Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) operations CAD design and 3D printing This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock. This apprenticeship trains you for a variety of maintenance roles - mechatronic maintenance technician, maintenance engineer, mechanical fitter, and electrical engineer - with plenty of opportunities for progression both within RME and more widely across Amazon. This could be the start of an exciting and rewarding career. You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.
