Work Most of your apprenticeship is spent working. You’ll learn on the job by getting hands-on experience. What you'll do at work As one of the world's most advanced technology-driven companies, we're powered by automation, robotics, and continuous innovation - from robotic arms to complex conveyor networks and smart sensor technology that keep millions of customer orders moving. This apprenticeship gives you the chance to become a multi-skilled maintenance technician across both electrical and mechanical disciplines, with hands-on experience on industry-leading equipment, some of which only exists at Amazon. Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is fundamental to our operations - they keep vital machinery running around the clock. As an RME Mechatronics Apprentice, you'll help maintain a wide range of equipment while upholding health and safety best practice, keeping your colleagues safe, preventing downtime, and improving the availability and quality of our equipment. You'll thrive here if you stay calm when things go wrong and get a real kick out of fixing them. You're hands-on, curious about how machines work, and you understand that keeping production moving is what it's all about. And you don't need to be a qualified engineer to start - what matters most is a practical, problem-solving mindset and a hunger to learn. A day in the life can involve: Carrying out proactive and preventative maintenance Carrying out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse Using the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness Making modifications and upgrades to existing equipment Upholding health and safety policies and practices Working on continuous improvement projects, and suggesting long-term improvements Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll build a broad, in-demand engineering skillset, including: Fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance Mechanical device maintenance, and fluid power systems assembly and testing Electrical equipment wiring and testing Hydraulics and pneumatics Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) operations CAD design and 3D printing This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock. This apprenticeship trains you for a variety of maintenance roles - mechatronic maintenance technician, maintenance engineer, mechanical fitter, and electrical engineer - with plenty of opportunities for progression both within RME and more widely across Amazon. This could be the start of an exciting and rewarding career. You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employee

items.text:
Job title : Volvo Apprentice HGV Technician - Wellingborough Vacancy ID : 14169 Postcode : NN8 6AQ Recruitment Advisor : Arif Shah Recruiter email : address : Rutherford Drive Hourly rate : £8.72 Programme Name : Level 3 - Heavy Vehicle Service and Maintenance Technician Anticipated Interview Date : 2026-01-11 00:00:00 Anticipated start date : 2027-05-03 00:00:00 Employer description :
The first Volvo truck was born in 1928. Since then, they have grown to become the largest producer of heavy trucks in Europe. Their reliability is renowned. And it’s underpinned by their three core values of quality, safety and environmental care. With a network of over 85 fully equipped Volvo Truck & Bus workshops throughout the UK and Ireland, customers can count on their certified technicians to keep your Volvo truck in optimal condition.
Why choose Volvo Truck and Bus?
Industry Leader: Join a globally recognised brand at the forefront of innovation in the commercial vehicle industry.
Cutting-Edge Technology : Work with state-of-the-art Volvo trucks and buses, gaining hands-on experience with the latest technological advancements.
Expert Training : Benefit from a comprehensive apprenticeship program that combines classroom learning and practical on-the-job training.
VOLVO TRUCKS APPRENTICESHIPS NOW OPEN FOR 2027!
Start dates are May to August 2027
Join the Future of Heavy Vehicle Engineering – Volvo Truck & Bus Apprenticeships 2027
Are you ready to kick-start a career that keeps the world moving? Volvo Truck & Bus is opening applications for HGV Technician Apprenticeships starting in 2027 – and we want motivated, hands-on individuals to join our team.
Are you passionate about trucks, buses and the world of heavy vehicles? Do you have a knack for solving mechanical puzzles and want to turn your passion into a profession? Look no further - Volvo Truck and Bus is seeking enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Apprentice HGV Technicians!
What You'll Do: • Assist with repairs that are carried out in accordance with Volvo Standard Times using Volvo Special Tools where appropriate. • Assist in the fault diagnosis process. • Learn and comply with warranty procedures during repairs and with warranty material on completion of repair. • Assist and work with the parts team to ensure the correct replacement parts are fitted to the vehicles • Learn how to use Volvo special tools safely and efficiently. • Assist with cleaning the workshop. • Assist with ensuring that the company time recording procedures are complied with and that job cards are completed accurately • Ensure all vehicle defects are reported to the workshop Supervisor. • Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) when it must be worn. • Attend college courses regularly and achieve the standards required by the course. • Attend any technical or development training that is made available On starting your Apprenticeship, you will be provided with full equipment which includes all the tools to help you become a technician. You will work with qualified and experienced Technicians learning how to repair, service, MOT and maintain modern trucks, buses and coaches including hybrid technology… and so much more to learn.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
We have an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic, dedicated and forward-thinking Receptionist/Admin Assistant reporting to the School Business Manager to join our well-established nursery team at Croyland Nursery School & Day Nursery, all year round. The hours of work are:-
Monday 2pm - 6pm
Tuesday 2pm - 6pm
Wednesday 2pm-6pm
Thursday 8am-12pm
Friday 2pm-6pm
To carry out administrative and general office duties, as required, providing an efficient and effective service for the Nursery School, in support of the school’s Executive Headteacher. To provide reliable support to the federation’s Executive Headteacher across many competing priorities needing accurate and timely administrative support.
The Role
The job holder is responsible for carrying out a range of administrative duties such as maintaining the pupil database, assisting with the preparation of invoices for fee paying families, preparing stationery orders, replenishing first aid supplies, preparing outgoing post and distributing post and messages to staff. In addition, they also carry out other general office duties such as photocopying and filing as required.
In support of the Executive Headteacher, they will provide administrative support, which, although not exhaustive, may include communicating messages to the wider business management team, coordinating diaries, collating information, preparing reports and monitoring returns against deadlines.
Main accountabilities
To receive deliveries for the school.
Covering the main reception and taking calls
To carry out basic office duties such as photocopying, filing, dealing with general enquiries to ensure the provision of an efficient and effective administration service for the nursery.
Taking payments from families.
Greeting parents, children and families when they arrive at nursery each day.
Collating data into spreadsheets.
Generating reports where needed.
Preparing documents ahead of meetings.
Knowledge, experience and training
Good general level of education including Maths and English to GCSE/O level standard.
Experience of dealing with people/providing customer service e.g. previous experience of working as a receptionist.
Previous office experience.
Computer literate with experience of MS packages.
Personal Qualities
To be able to work independently organising self to complete routine tasks.
To be able to prioritise workload and communicate as appropriate any difficulties or challenges experienced.
To be able to use initiative and pre-empt requirements of others.
To be a team player with the ability to support a small school with tasks as required.
Communication
The jobholder must have a good telephone manner and effective interpersonal skills.
The jobholder deals with enquiries, provides information to parents, visitors, pupils and staff, face to face and over the telephone. The jobholder must ensure that they are approachable, polite and courteous.
To communicate professionally, using negotiating skills, when making enquiries to obtain information from third parties, including contractors.
To be able to provide professional and concise written reports.
Visits to our school are encouraged. We will try to accommodate the most convenient time to interested candidates.
Start date: ASAP
Croyland Nursery School & Day Nursery is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all children. All appointments are subject to successful Disclosure & Barring clearance, references and medical clearance. The school provides equal opportunities for all. Please note that it is an offence to apply for the role if the applicant is barred from engaging in regulated activity relevant to children.

items.text: At Aldi, no day is the same. Every day brings something new —you'll be at the heart of the store, ensuring everything runs seamlessly. From receiving deliveries and stocking shelves to assisting customers and creating a welcoming atmosphere, your role is vital. items.title: Office Administrator / Receptionist
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
We’re looking for a friendly and organised Office Administrator / Receptionist to help support the smooth running of ‘The Yard’, our major office in Raunds, Northamptonshire.
The Yard is home to hundreds of colleagues working across teams including IT, Marketing, Finance and Commercial, all helping to keep Howdens running. It’s also home to our Expo and showroom, where trade customers and members of the public can explore our products and speak with our experts.
This is an initial 8-month fixed-term contract, working 25 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 12:30pm–5:30pm. Due to the location of the site, a driving licence and access to your own transport are recommended.
What you’ll be doing as an Office Administrator:
Providing professional reception cover, including welcoming visitors, handling enquiries, and managing calls
Supporting the EA and Office Manager in the day-to-day running of The Yard, ensuring the office is maintained to a consistently high standard
Managing incoming and outgoing post, stationery orders and general office supplies
Managing meeting room bookings and ensuring rooms are prepared and reset to a high standard after use
Carrying out regular facilities checks across the building and managing the maintenance tracker, including liaising with suppliers and escalating urgent issues
Coordinating with approved suppliers for repairs and maintenance (e.g. lighting, air conditioning, painting)
Coordinating travel arrangements, taxis and couriers as required
Supporting health and safety processes, including inductions, documentation and coordinating training where needed
Assisting with general administration, including raising purchase orders, processing invoices and maintaining accurate records
Supporting wider office operations such as access card management, timesheets, office moves and supplier coordination
What we are looking for from you:
Previous experience in an office administration, facilities or reception-based role
A proactive and organised approach, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively
Strong communication skills, with the confidence to interact professionally with internal and external stakeholders
A high level of attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards across the office environment
A flexible and hands-on attitude, with a willingness to support across a variety of responsibilities
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
A team-focused mindset, with the ability to build strong working relationships across the business
About Howdens: Howdens Joinery is a highly successful FTSE 100 business, with more than 900 depots nationwide and more than 11,000 staff. Last year our sales reached circa 2.3bn, and we continue to experience significant growth and success. Despite our scale, Howdens remains a local business with traditional values. There is a strong entrepreneurial ethos and the opportunity to develop within a fast-paced and commercial environment. That, along with a competitive salary, development opportunities, and exciting rewards, are among the reasons why our people enjoy working for Howdens – and why we have been named one of the 10 Best Big Companies to Work For.
Howdens is founded on the principle of being Worthwhile for ALL concerned. We’re working hard to ensure we provide an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome. We will do everything we can to support you during your application. If you need us to make any adjustments to our recruitment process, please email with the job title and location, and we will be happy to help you.
Please note that candidates applying for this role must have a valid right to work in the UK, we do not offer sponsorship of employment for any depot positions at this time. We appreciate your understanding.
#LI-LO1 #CVL INDKSD #Reed

items.title: Warehouse Operative
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Join Our Growing Team at Warburtons!
Function: Distribution
Contract: 4 on 2 off rota. 6pm - 3am
Salary: £675.18
Join the team behind the UK’s No.1 bakery brand and help keep households stocked with the products millions know and love. The Biggleswade site is a modern, state-of-the-art operation featuring the latest iCart technology and a fast-growing So, if you’re a Warehouse Team Member or Operative, looking for a role with a bit more substance (and crust!), this could be your moment to prove you’re made of the right stuff.
Previous experience as a Warehouse Operative ideally gained in a food environment
Detailed knowledge and experience of working towards all SOPs which effect a warehouse
Effective manual handling techniques training undertaken
Knowledge of SAP to enable allocation of product and closing of orders
Understanding of requirements of Hygiene & Food Safety Legislation
Good communication skills- a team player, listens to others, respects differences in personal style and beliefs
Can prioritise and manage own workload to ensure tasks are delivered as promised
Decision making skills – makes effective decisions in areas affecting own job
Numeracy – mental arithmetic skills
Basic IT skills
As a Warehouse Team Member, you’ll be at the heart of our operations, ensuring smooth, efficient processes while upholding our reputation for exceptional service. Your key responsibilities will include:
To assemble and complete all orders on time and in full for primary and secondary distribution routes (where applicable). Identify deficits and take appropriate action to ensure the deficit is evenly distributed across all customers.
To ensure products despatched, comply with quality and date code requirements and comply with food safety legislation, initiating any required action.
To maintain Company hygiene and statutory hygiene standards throughout designated areas, working within the principles of basic food hygiene and good housekeeping.
To complete all paperwork on a timely and regular basis to ensure accurate recording and reporting of information.
To communicate progress on tasks with team members, highlighting operational issues to Team Manager or Managers (where applicable)
To stack and store all equipment in the appropriate areas, ensuring operational areas are safe and kept clear of equipment.
At Warburtons, we believe in investing in our people. You will be supported with a full induction and ongoing training from our in-house teams. Your knowledge of basic warehouse operations and transport legislation will be key for a smooth and safe day.
As the UK’s No. 1 Bakery Brand, we have been baking bread since 1876. Today, we are proudly a sixth-generation family business, supplying over 18,000 retail customers from 23 distribution sites, producing a range of over 70 products, including gluten and wheat-free options. We are striving to be a net-zero business by 2050 and believe in minimizing our impact on the environment while making a positive impact on society.
Biggleswade is known for being the home of the world's first-ever seed company, founded by Samuel Wells in the 18th century. Warburtons' newest site is conveniently situated with access to the A1, providing a gateway to the North and South, as well as easy access to both the East and West parts of England. Alongside its agricultural heritage, Biggleswade is ideally situated along the River Ivel and has a long-standing tradition of weekly markets dating back to the Middle Ages.
At last and by no means least you will want to know what your breads worth:
A slice of the annual profits (discretionary profit share)
Award winning pension scheme with company contributions up to 7%
Life assurance
Products you will love along with deals and discounts for you and the family through our Extra Dough website
Continued investment in your personal development
Fully stocked kitchens filled with our delicious products for you to enjoy with your daily brew!
Support for your health and wellbeing, including access to free physiotherapy, 24/7 access to a confidential helpline for practical advice and a comprehensive occupational health service

items.text:
A growing food manufacturer are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer where practical problem-solving, continuous improvement, and hands-on coaching truly matter. As a Manufacturing Engineer, Training & Continuous Improvement, you will help build capable, confident teams while supporting the technical integration of existing and new production equipment.
Salary £42,000 to £50,000 plus Benefits
Monday to Friday 8.30am till 5.30pm
What You Will Do:
Support the integration, optimisation, and continuous improvement of production equipment and processes.
Deliver fault diagnosis, root cause analysis, repairs, and maintenance improvement initiatives to protect line efficiency.
Train and coach operators and line personnel through practical classroom-based sessions across mechanics, hydraulics, and pneumatics.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve training materials, work instructions, and technical documentation.
Help manage maintenance resources to maintain equipment availability while keeping budget control on track.
Champion a safety-first culture by ensuring compliance with Health and Safety policies and procedures.
What You Will Bring:
Demonstrable hands-on technical knowledge of production equipment and processes, including troubleshooting and repair activities.
Experience delivering practical training and coaching across a range of engineering disciplines, ideally including mechanics, hydraulics, and pneumatics.
Strong ability to identify the root cause of problems, using data, observations, and performance indicators to drive practical solutions.
Clear communication skills to explain technical concepts confidently, tailoring the message to different audiences and skill levels.
Computer literacy and familiarity with using maintenance or production systems.
Apprenticeship, HNC or HND in Engineering.
This Manufacturing Engineer, Training & Continuous Improvement role sits within the fast-paced food manufacturing sector and supports this company's ongoing focus on growth, quality, and putting consumers first. By strengthening equipment performance and developing autonomous teams, your work directly contributes to safer operations, stronger production reliability, and continuous improvement that keeps manufacturing moving forward.
Location:
Milton Keynes, UK.
Interested?:
If you're ready to combine manufacturing engineering with training and continuous improvement, apply for the Manufacturing Engineer, Training & Continuous Improvement role today and take the next step in your career.
Your CV will be forwarded to Jonathan Lee Recruitment, a leading engineering and manufacturing recruitment consultancy established in 1978. The services advertised by Jonathan Lee Recruitment are those of an Employment Agency. In order for your CV to be processed effectively, please ensure your name, email address, phone number and location (post code OR town OR county, as a minimum) are included.

Cemeteries Grounds Maintenance Operatives Location: Northampton Hourly Rate: £13.45 per hour Contract Type: Permanent, Full-time Working Hours: 37 hours. Monday - Friday, to take place between 0700 and 1630 About the role We are looking for experienced Grounds Maintenance Operatives to join the Cemetery Services team in Northampton. In this role, you will be responsible for a range of tasks including the preparation, excavation and backfilling of graves as well as overseeing the general maintenance of the cemetery grounds, ensuring they remain tidy, well-kept and respectful for visitors and loved ones. Your work will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation of the cemetery, whilst upholding professionalism, dignity and care for the environment at all times. Requirements
Experience as a Grounds Maintenance Operative, including grass cutting, strimming, hedge cutting and flower bed maintenance.
Experience with cemetery work, grave digging and burial processes, with formal burial training would be highly advantageous.
A COTS (Cemetery Operatives Training Scheme) certification is beneficial but all training can be provided by idverde to the successful candidate.
Previous 360 Excavator & Dumper experience also beneficial, but training for this can also be provided.
A full valid UK driving license is essential.
Can-do attitude and safety-conscious mindset.
Physically fit and able to work outdoors in all weather conditions.
We are committed to providing a safe working environment for all employees. In line with our Drug and Alcohol Policy, employees may be subject to drug and/or alcohol testing during their employment. Why join us? As the UK's leading grounds maintenance and landscape creation provider, no two projects are ever the same - and neither are our people. That's why we're committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. We're proud to have been recognised as Employer of the Year and Sustainable Company of the Year at this year's Landscaper Awards, reflecting our commitment to supporting our people while delivering a more sustainable future. What we offer
Career advancement and development opportunities through our bespoke apprenticeship programmes, our extensive in-house training academy, and coaching and mentorship.
A diverse and inclusive workplace where you can collaborate with passionate and talented individuals.
Contribute to projects that have a meaningful impact & make a real difference in the community and environment.
We recognise and reward your hard work with our wide-ranging competitive benefits package designed to prioritise your wellbeing, support life choices, and help in both good and challenging times.
Benefits
21 days holiday plus bank holidays.
Full Workwear & PPE provided.
Healthcare & Wellbeing platform.
Enhanced maternity and shared parental leave.
Support for personal and professional challenges.
Discounts on retail, holidays, gym memberships, and more.
Secure your future - resources to manage your finances
Colleague of the month and annual awards.
Two days per year to support a cause of your choice.
Comprehensive resources and support.
About idverde We are Europe's largest provider of grounds maintenance services and landscape creation, in the UK alone we're a community of over 3,000 passionate colleagues shaping the future of the green industry. At idverde, we understand what it means to grow. Our history dates back to 1919, and today, with a turnover of £250 million, we're more than just a company - we're a force for positive change. We offer a range of services to create, maintain, and manage landscapes across the UK. Grow with us, and together we'll create a greener future for all.
If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.

items.title: Skilled Labour & Maintenance Operative
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Skilled Labour & Maintenance operative
MCR Property Group
Luton
About us
MCR Property Group is a leading independent real estate investment and development company with a strong presence across the UK. We operate from offices in Manchester, London, Birmingham, and Glasgow.
Our business focuses on developing new residential and industrial projects and actively managing a diverse portfolio, including approximately 5,000 residential plots and commercial and industrial assets valued at more than £2 billion.
As we enter an exciting period of continued growth, we are looking for motivated, reliable, and self-driven people who take pride in their work and have a genuine interest in property and building maintenance. You will join a supportive team committed to quality, consistency, and long-term success.
The opportunity
MCR Property Group is seeking a Skilled Labourer to join our team in Luton. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a fast-paced, thriving business offering genuine opportunities for growth and long-term development. Your skills will be valued, and your contribution will directly support the delivery and performance of high-quality property assets.
Responsibilities
Maintenance and repairs: Carry out routine maintenance works and reactive repairs across residential, commercial, and industrial properties.
General building work: Undertake tapering and jointing, wider carpentry, and minor plumbing, electrical, carpentry, and HVAC repairs.
Building systems: Inspect and maintain building systems and equipment so they remain safe, compliant, and fully operational.
Maintenance requests: Respond to requests in a timely and efficient manner.
Fixtures and appliances: Install, repair, and replace fixtures and appliances where required.
Work areas: Keep all working areas clean, safe, and well organised.
Communication: Communicate clearly with property managers, colleagues, and tenants as necessary.
Teamwork: Coordinate effectively with other team members to ensure work is completed smoothly and efficiently.
Record keeping: Maintain clear and accurate logs of maintenance and repair activities undertaken.
Essential requirements
Proven experience in a labouring role within a maintenance team
Strong working knowledge of general repair and maintenance tasks.
Basic understanding of plumbing, electrical, carpentry, and HVAC systems.
Ability to use hand and power tools safely and effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills and good attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and as part of a wider team.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
A proactive and reliable approach to work.
A full driving licence and reliable transport.
Happy to travel between various sites, but based predominantly in Luton.
Your own tools.
What we offer
In return, MCR Property Group offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package:
Holiday: 20 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, increasing by one additional day for each completed year of service up to a maximum of 25 days.
Birthday: Your birthday off.
Dress code: A relaxed dress-down policy on Fridays.
Eye care: A free eye test voucher.
Mileage: Reimbursement at 55p per business mile for work-related travel.
Career progression: Genuine opportunities for career progression within the company.
Training and development: Training, development opportunities, and ongoing health and safety training.

Here at GXO, we are currently recruiting for a Maintenance Engineer to join our team in Milton Keynes, supporting our customer Waitrose. As a Maintenance Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring that the depot and associated facilities are maintained in a safe operating manner, that the buildings are maintained to the highest possible standards, in accordance with legislation and best practices.
This is a full time, permanent position, predominately working Sunday to Thursday , 21:30 to 05:30.
Pay, benefits and more:
We’re looking to offer a salary of up to £38,080.00 per annum (inclusive of shift allowance) and 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays). Your benefits package includes flexible dental insurance plans, a company sponsored pension scheme, a 24/7 online GP service, life assurance and a fully comprehensive employee assistance programme. You’ll also have access to our MyBenefits platform offering a variety of high street discounts, a cycle to work scheme, cashback cards, a saving scheme and much more!
What you’ll do on a typical day:
Assist the Engineering manager to ensure all contractual obligations are carried out fully, successfully and with the minimum disruption
Monitoring/maintenance of large industrial ammonia refrigeration plants, ensuring that it is available and maintained to optimum performance levels at all times
Planned and reactive plumbing and drainage maintenance
Electrical testing and fault finding
What you need to succeed at GXO:
Engineering qualification such City & Guilds, NVQ level 3 is essential
Strong mechanical/electrical skills, ideally being electrically bias would be advantageous
18 Edition wiring is essential
We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.
GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. GXO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate, support and thrive on diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe that diversity and inclusion in our business is critical to our success as a global company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. We are an Armed Forces friendly organisation and Disability Confident Leader as part of the Disability Confident Scheme (GIS) and actively welcome applications from people with disabilities.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement

To provide a comprehensive maintenance and site support service, ensuring the safe, effective and efficient operation of facilities, equipment and workplace services. Collect, move and install office furniture, including the assembly of flat-pack furniture.

Support the Facilities and Maintenance team with day-to-day site activities as required.
Operate site vehicles and equipment, including forklift trucks (training provided where required).
Set up and dismantle rooms, furniture and equipment for meetings, events and site activities.

Carry out routine inspections, preventative maintenance activities and basic repairs.

Wellingborough, Northamptonshire

Full-time, permanent PAYE or long-term subcontract opportunity
Rise10 Recruitment are working with an established electrical business based in Wellingborough that is looking to add an experienced Electrician to its growing team.
This is a great opportunity for a time-served Electrician with a background in commercial installations who enjoys being hands-on, taking responsibility for day-to-day site activities and working closely with Contracts Managers. The company is also keen to support someone who wants to develop their skills and progress professionally.
You'll work across a varied range of residential, commercial and industrial projects, with opportunities to get involved in EV installations and commercial maintenance.
Installing, maintaining and repairing electrical systems across a variety of projects.
Taking responsibility for the day-to-day running of commercial electrical installations and coordinating work with other electricians.
Supporting and supervising junior electricians and apprentices, sharing your knowledge and experience.
Working closely with Contracts Managers to keep projects running smoothly and efficiently.
Inspecting electrical systems, identifying faults and implementing effective solutions.
Carrying out electrical testing and inspections, including EICRs where experienced.
Maintaining accurate records of work completed, materials used and time spent on tasks.
Ensuring all work meets relevant electrical regulations, health and safety requirements and company procedures.
Communicating effectively with customers, colleagues and management to keep everyone up to date.
What we're looking for
A time-served Electrician with ideally around five years' experience.
Experience working on commercial electrical installations and coordinating the day-to-day work of an installation team.
A Level 3 Diploma in Electrical Installation.
18th Edition Wiring Regulations.
A full UK driving licence.
A positive, professional approach with good communication skills and a commitment to safe working.
Someone keen to develop their skills and progress within the business.
Desirable, but not essential:
ECS Gold Card.
2391 Inspection and Testing qualification.
Experience carrying out domestic and commercial EICRs.

Salary of up to £50,000, depending on experience, for a permanent PAYE position.
Long-term subcontract opportunities available.
Company van.
22 days' annual leave, with three days to be reserved for the Christmas shutdown.
Monday to Friday working, typically eight-hour shifts.

The opportunity to benefit from a profit-share arrangement on new customers you bring into the business.
Support for ongoing professional development and the opportunity to grow with the company.

Experience in general building maintenance or a multi trade role.

Strong customer service skills and effective communication abilities.

Physical fitness for frequent physical tasks.
Proficiency in workflow software and technology-driven processes.

The Electrical Inspector is the first line of defence against electrical defects in our production environment. items.text:
First Response Group is seeking a motivated Trainee CCTV Engineer to join our expanding engineering team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long term career within the security and surveillance industry.
As a Trainee CCTV Engineer, you will receive comprehensive training and hands-on experience working alongside skilled engineers across a range of security solutions. This includes fixed CCTV installations, temporary CCTV towers, and solar- and battery-powered surveillance systems.
During your initial training period, you will learn the fundamentals of installation, maintenance, and fault-finding. As your knowledge and confidence grow, you will progress to independently installing and maintaining our temporary CCTV solutions before moving on to more advanced fixed CCTV and integrated security systems.
A company van will be provided, and upon successful completion of your training, you will be expected to work independently while remaining fully supported by our wider engineering team.
This role is ideally suited to a reliable, self-motivated individual with a practical, hands-on approach and a strong willingness to learn. You should be comfortable working independently with minimal supervision and keen to develop new technical skills. Previous experience within CCTV, security systems, electrical work, or a related field would be advantageous but is not essential, as full training will be provided.
First Response Group is not just a workplace. It is a vibrant community where passion fuels our excellence, integrity guides our conduct, empowerment shapes our successes, and a sense of community binds us together. is a dynamic and forward-thinking provider of security, risk management, and facilities solutions.
We distinguish ourselves through the integration of cutting-edge technology, a commitment to employee development, and a culture rooted in inclusivity and positivity. At FRG, every team member’s contribution is valued, and collective success is celebrated.
Assist with the installation, maintenance, and servicing of temporary and fixed CCTV systems.
Support senior engineers with planned and reactive maintenance tasks.
Install and maintain temporary CCTV towers, including solar and battery-powered solutions.
Carry out basic fault finding and troubleshooting on CCTV and security equipment.
Ensure all installations are completed safely and to company standards.
Travel to customer sites across the UK as required.
Complete installation and maintenance reports accurately and on time.
Maintain company vehicles, tools, and equipment in good condition.
Adhere to all health and safety procedures and company policies.
Provide excellent customer service while representing First Response Group professionally.
Participate in ongoing training and development to enhance technical knowledge and skills.
Essential:
Full UK driving licence.
Practical and hands-on approach to work.
Willingness to learn and develop new technical skills.
Ability to work independently and use initiative.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong work ethic and reliable attitude.
Good communication skills.
Flexibility to travel and work at various locations.

items.title: Electrician
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Join us, be part of more.
We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that's energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion, and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently - we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it, and mend it.
About your team:
At British Gas, our mission is to sell it and mend it.
We’ve been powering the UK’s homes and businesses for over 200 years – but supplying energy is just part of what we do. We’re making the UK greener and more energy efficient, getting closer to Net Zero. By using clever tech like thermostats, heat pumps, solar panels and EV chargers, we’re making it cheaper and easier for our customers to reduce their carbon-footprint.
About your role:
We’re looking for skilled Electricians to join our experienced Field Engineering team , helping ensure customers receive safe, high-quality electrical work exactly when they need it. Being there for our customers is our priority, and you’ll play a key role in delivering same-day fixes and high standards of electrical safety in customers’ homes.
Salary & Rewards
Base salary: £43,045
Uncapped OTE: £51,389 is a realistic expectation through our comprehensive field reward scheme.
The Role
As an Electrician, you’ll use your technical expertise to deliver safe, high-quality electrical work in domestic properties, including:
Fault finding and repairs
Electrical installations and upgrades
Full and partial rewires
Ensuring all work is completed safely, compliantly, and right first time
You’ll combine strong technical capability with excellent customer service, diagnosing issues efficiently, achieving first-time fixes , and providing professional advice to customers where appropriate.
Training & Development
While EV charging and other Net Zero technologies are not a current responsibility of the role, they form an important part of our future. We offer potential opportunities for electricians to train, upskill, and gain additional qualifications in emerging technologies as the role evolves, making this a strong long-term career opportunity.
What We’re Looking For
Minimum 2 years’ experience working as a qualified electrician
City & Guilds 2365 Parts 1 & 2 (or equivalent), culminating in a Level 3 Technical Certificate , including the NET AM2
City & Guilds 2382 – B.S. 7671 IET Wiring Regulations
Proven experience working in the electrical industry
City & Guilds 2391/52 (or equivalent) – highly desirable
Willingness to undertake potential future training in Net Zero technologies
Why should you apply?
We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too.
If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.
Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

Maintenance Engineer (Electrical Bias)
Annual Salary: £48,000 + overtime + Annual Bonus
Location: CB24
Job Type: Full-time, Day Shift (Monday-Friday, 8:00am-4:00pm or 9:00am-5:00pm)
Join a family-owned business with a strong reputation for good working conditions and a focus on high-quality maintenance services. We are expanding our team and looking for an Electrical Maintenance Engineer with a strong electronics bias to handle hands-on repairs and fault-finding tasks, primarily on vacuum machinery and related electronics.
Day-to-day of the role:
Diagnose and repair circuit boards and PCBs using your strong electrical and electronics knowledge.
Utilise electrical drawings and schematics for effective fault-finding.
Engage in hands-on repairs and maintenance tasks, focusing on vacuum machinery rather than commercial building maintenance.
Work within a team of experienced engineers, contributing to the maintenance of high standards and efficient operations.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
Proven background as an Electrical biased Maintenance Engineer with significant electronics experience.
Qualified to ONC/HNC level in Electronic/Electrical Engineering (desired).
Proficient in using Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and capable of reading circuit and wiring diagrams.
Strong soldering skills and familiarity with BS7671 and 17th Edition Wiring Regulations.
Experience with high voltage systems, RF systems, and PLCs (Allen Bradley, Siemens) highly desired.
Calibration and high vacuum experience are advantageous.
Benefits:
24 days holiday, increasing with service, plus bank holidays.
Company pension scheme.
Profit-related pay bonus.
Overtime opportunities available.
Interview Process:
Stage 1: Site tour, face-to-face interview, and technical questioning.
Stage 2: Further interview, written trade test, and a small practical assessment.
To apply for this Maintenance Engineer position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role. We are looking for candidates who can start ASAP and contribute effectively to our team

Insight Employment are seeking a Welder Fabricator for a client of ours in Bedford.

At the heart of their business the standard is set and therefore quality of workmanship and meeting set deadlines are a must and full dedication must be given to this while maintaining the highest levels of health and safety.
You must be able to follow fabrication drawings and instruction while being vocal if for any reason, you realise either a mistake in drawings or your own work. Noticed conflicts must be reported along with any structural elements that cannot be met within the build of the product whether it be through weld or material being used.
As with every role within the company, they employ you due to your knowledge and skill set and therefore value any constructive feedback to assist with the company improving its product of systems.
Responsibilities: –
Read, interpret, and follow basic diagrams and engineering drawings, specifications, weld symbols, bills of materials, and other written instructions or procedures to accurately create equipment and products.
Preferably, candidate with ARC MIG and TIG experience in aluminium and steel.
Utilize handheld tools such as a handheld screw gun, drill gun, and grinders.
Operate callipers, weld gauges, tape measures, and other welding hand tools.
Maintain weld machines using preventative maintenance methods.
Continually evaluate weld machine performance and technology to improve cycle times.
Maintain inventory of manufacturing products and welding consumables.
Create specific weldment set-ups and fixturing to meet geometric requirements.
Perform quality work checks to ensure the product meets quality standards.
Identify product defects and complete appropriate documentation when defects are identified.
Rework and/or repair welded parts and products according to engineering specification changes.
Perform all work in accordance with quality standards and established safety procedures.
Prioritize workflow through effective communication with management staff.
Maintain a clean and safe work area.
Perform welding and fabrication tasks according to detailed plans and specifications.
Ensure all fabricated components meet the company’s quality and safety standards.
Maintain welding equipment and ensure the workspace is clean and organised.
Collaborate with other workshop staff to meet production deadlines.
Uphold and promote the company’s core values.
Any other duties as required.
Qualification requirements: –
Ability to perform work accurately and thoroughly.
Ability to use thinking and reasoning to solve a problem.
High attention to detail and self-motivation skills.
Specific technical or vocational training or certification preferred.
Work in a team environment and respect all teammates.
The above is not an exhaustive list and in addition to the above duties, you may be required to perform other duties. We will not ask you to do anything which is beyond your capabilities. As the needs of their business change, they will amend the above duties accordingly.
The duties described in this job description must be carried out in a manner which promotes equality of opportunity; dignity and due respect for all employees and clients or customers is consistent with the Company’s Equal Opportunities Policy.

 Other requirements : 
 Because of the work we do at Thales, all roles are subject to security requirements. To be considered for this position, you must have the permanent right to work in the UK and be able to successfully complete and maintain UK Government security checks, including Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening and Security Clearance (SC), which is a government background check, before starting employment.

items.text:
Maintenance Electrician - Buckingham - £45,000 plus benefits
Melbreck Technical is working with a leading designer and manufacturer of specialist products used in a wide range of industries, including housing, transport & logistics, warehousing and storage.
Due to a fantastic 2026, they want to expand their facilities and manufacturing capabilities by investing in their site in Buckingham, and as such they are looking for a Maintenance Electrician to start on a permanent contract ASAP.
The Role:
Working in a fast-moving production environment, you will be carrying out Electrical preventative maintenance duties across the site, attending breakdowns, carrying out overhauls on machinery, completing remedial corrective work, and improving the plant’s availability and reliability.
Day-to-day duties will include:
Working on the site systems, including Electrical infrastructure/ Lighting/ Fire Alarms / Motor controls and compressed air
To carry out essential maintenance and complete necessary repairs to keep the factory in good working order.
Promote the development and implementation of the Factory PPM system.
Provide electrical maintenance cover through effective and efficient response to plant breakdowns throughout the factory.
Involvement in process improvement throughout the factory, creating new ideas and developing better solutions.
Monitor & supply Engineering support for machine set-up & changeovers to ensure that the product conforms to any quality assurance standards and ensuring changeovers are as efficient as possible.
Daily liaison with the duty Maintenance Engineering Manager to ensure that all production maintenance requirements are undertaken.
Some overtime may well be necessary to cover production and PPM’s
Monitor and control spare parts needed to ensure production uptime.
Some smaller installation works required e.g. new three-phase supply to machinery or similar.
Work to a high level of Health and Safety
Manage own workload
Updating site Maintenance CMMS system
Job Skills and Requirements:
• Knowledge of 18th Edition Electrical installation regulations desirable.
• Ideally qualified to ONC / HNC or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering.
• Capable of fault-finding control systems, including PLC-controlled automation in a production environment.
• Knowledge of three-phase industrial control systems.
• Knowledge of Thermal imaging desirable (training can be given)
• Good IT Skills
So, do you want to join an expanding business where you can make a big difference? Click Apply NOW!

Location: Northampton Salary: £56,500 per annum Shift Pattern: 4 on, 4 off days and nights
We are looking for a motivated and technically strong Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineer to join a busy, highly automated warehouse and distribution operation in Northampton.
This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast-paced environment where engineering reliability is critical to keeping operations running efficiently. You will play a key role in maintaining, fault-finding and improving automated materials handling and distribution systems, minimising downtime and maximising equipment performance.
Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance across automated warehouse equipment and systems.
Diagnose and resolve electrical and mechanical faults to minimise operational downtime.

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to improve equipment reliability and operational efficiency.
Ensure all maintenance activities comply with health and safety procedures and site standards.

items.text:
Retail Merchandiser
Retail Merchandiser
**This role requires a full driving licence with access to your own vehicle, and for some roles you must be able to accept home deliveries for POS materials**
Working Days: Monday 9am - 14pm, Wednesday 9am - 14pm, Friday 9am - 14pm Working Hours: 15 Hours a week Location: Milton Keynes Sainsburys, MK9 2FW
An ideal candidate would also be able to cover various retailers, M&S / Sainsburys / Boots / Lidl / Co-op, within these postcode areas of MK1, MK4, MK5, MK9, MK10.
Join Dee Set, Part of Acosta Europe
Be the reason shoppers notice the brand.
At Dee Set, part of Acosta Europe, we help some of the UK's biggest brands create outstanding in-store experiences. From product launches to eye-catching displays, our teams play a vital role in bringing brands to life where it matters most. We're committed to developing our people, recognising great work, and providing flexible opportunities that help our colleagues succeed.
If you enjoy variety, independence and making a visible difference, we'd love to hear from you.
What's In It for You?
? Exclusive colleague discounts & rewards hub ? Stream – opportunity to release up to 40% of your wages early ? Flexible working with the potential for additional hours based on needs ? Grocery Aid – support with mental health, money issues etc. ? Holiday allowance plus extra days for long service ? Full training, ongoing support, and career development opportunities ? Access to The Colleague Hub with year-round savings and benefits ? Contributory pension scheme (eligibility applies)
The Role
As a Retail Merchandiser, you'll play a key role in bringing some of the UK's biggest brands to life across leading retailers including Asda, Tesco, Sainsbury's, Boots, Marks & Spencer and Co-op.
Working across categories such as health & beauty, cosmetics, confectionery, greetings cards and grocery, you'll ensure products are available, displayed to a high standard and ready for customers to purchase. From launching new products and installing promotional displays to supporting seasonal campaigns, you'll help brands stand out and drive sales in store.
This is a varied, hands-on role where no two days are the same. You'll work independently, manage your own schedule and build strong relationships with store colleagues to deliver exceptional standards every time.
What You'll Do
Merchandise and replenish products, ensuring excellent availability and presentation
Build displays, install POS materials and support promotional and seasonal campaigns
Conduct store audits and complete photo-based reporting using a mobile device
Build positive relationships with store colleagues to support successful delivery of activity
Deliver all tasks accurately, compliantly and within agreed deadlines
About you
You will need to be a driver with access to your own vehicle, and be able to accept home deliveries for POS material (in-store marketing materials / displays)
You have a smart mobile device and are confident in basic IT including; downloading multiple apps to use concurrently, uploading photographs, completing surveys and reviewing data
A positive, reliable and proactive attitude
Great attention to detail and pride in a job well done
Confidence working independently and managing your own workload
Strong communication and relationship-building skills
A flexible approach and willingness to adapt to changing priorities
No merchandising experience? No problem. Full training is provided, so if you have the right attitude and a passion for delivering great standards, we'll give you the tools to succeed.

items.text: #BelongWithUs Come and join us as an HGV Cat C1 7.5t Driver on a flexible hours basis to help us grow, deliver sales and exceed customer expectations The role: As an HGV Cat C1 7.5t Driver, you’ll be committed to delivering an outstanding level of service, and you’ll be professional, driven and enthusiastic. The LGV Cat C1 7.5t Driver role reports into the branch management team and will provide the highest level of service to internal and external customers, and will deliver products to our customers against some very tight deadlines. As a PTS 7.5t Driver you will interact with our customers, delivering goods and solving any problems that crop up. Our HGV Cat C1 7.5t Drivers are a fundamental part of our branch teams and at times may be required to help out in branch - serving on the trade counter and dealing with customers over the telephone ensuring that we provide the best service and maximise sales at every opportunity. You will be contracted to a set minimum number of hours per week, and you will be required to be flexible to work additional hours to deliver the best customer experience, especially during the peak trading winter heating season. Where possible, hours and shifts will be agreed with you with plenty of notice so that you know exactly what you are doing and when! You’ll naturally promote and embrace our inclusive team environment and we’re sure you’ll have some fun along the way! Please note, this role requires you to have the appropriate HGV Cat C1 driving licence for 7.5t vehicles and CPC with previous experience as a driver Key Responsibilities: Health and safety of yourself and your vehicle Maintenance and condition of your vehicle Report any issues or incidents to your line manager Comply with transport compliance law and regulations Picking orders and loading vehicles Supporting the Branch Manager and Assistant Branch Manager with achieving and exceeding sales targets at optimum margins. Ensuring we maintain high standards, creating and maintaining a loyal customer base and providing a first class service. When needed, assisting with the general duties within the branch and warehouse such as serving customers on the trade counter, telesales and ensuring the housekeeping standards are maintained both on the trade counter and warehousing You: Along with a clean Cat C1 (7.5t) driving licence, you will ideally have previous driving experience and knowledge of the products associated with our industry would be an advantage. You'll be flexible with working hours, and your approach to delivering customer and business needs. You’ll thrive on providing the best customer service and being a huge support to your branch colleagues Us: From boilers to bathroom suites, tubing to towel rails and everything in between, we have all the products our customers need to complete the job. And we have all you need to build a successful career! With a network of more than 90 branches, PTS is ideally placed to meet the needs of customers, wherever they may be, and we offer a fast and efficient delivery service. PTS is also the sole supplier of key products and services to British Gas We’re proud of our reputation for selling quality plumbing and heating products to both trade and retail customers and we’re super excited about our future. We put our colleagues at the heart of all we do, giving them all the tools they need to be successful, happy and feel rewarded in their career with us. Benefits Package and Cultural Environment: Bonus Discounts, savings and cash back at numerous retailers Life assurance Extended family policy including maternity, paternity, additional annual leave and more Mental Health First Aiders and Employee Assistance Programme, we look out for each other Complete induction and a company that lets you grow and encourages development Financial education and loans Flexible working options A business striving to create an environment of inclusion so everyone can be their true self And more! #BelongWithUs We’re passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates and values diversity. Bring your whole self to work regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, *** or sexual orientation. We don’t want you to ‘fit’ our culture, we want you to enrich it. We are committed to best practices in recruitment and undertake Basic Criminal Record Disclosures for candidates that are offered employment within our branches that undertake deliveries for British Gas. This check will only be undertaken after the acceptance of an offer of employment.

items.title: Electrician – Milton Keynes/ Aylesbury
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Electrician – Using a company van to travel from your home to our pubs and restaurants in the Milton Keynes, Aylesbury and surrounding areas.
Looking for a better work life balance? No evening or weekend work is required in this role, nor is there an on-call rota – life is for living after all! Flexible working hours are also available, enabling you to fit work around your personal commitments…
About us…
Serving with pride since 1898, Mitchells & Butlers are the heart of UK hospitality. In fact, you already know us, even if you don’t realise it! We own and run more than 1,600 pubs, bars and restaurants including the stylish All Bar One brand, legendary Miller & Carter steakhouses, and the iconic Toby Carvery. We are Mitchells & Butlers, and we set the industry standard.
The Opportunity – Electrician
As an Electrician, you’ll use a company van to travel to our pubs and restaurants in the Milton Keynes, Aylesbury and surrounding areas (you’ll be allocated approximately 120 sites to look after), to carry out planned preventative maintenance to emergency lighting and fire alarms, plus reactive remedial electrical works required to issue a clean certificate. Don’t worry if you don’t have experience with fire alarm systems – we’ll provide all the training you need!
No two days will ever be the same! One day you might be working alone, carrying out electrical system test remedials, and the next teaming up with other colleagues to carry out larger works. You’ll use your great people skills to build relationships with Area and General Managers and promote the impact you have in ensuring safe pubs and restaurants in the local area.
There are no call outs, evening or weekend work giving you a great work life balance.
Please note you would need to reside in Milton Keynes, Aylesbury or a surrounding area to be considered for the position.
You’ll be well rewarded…
Annual Bonus
Permanent contract
Working 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with flexibility with working hours to fit around your personal commitments (e.g., 7am to 2pm, 8am to 3pm, etc.)
No evening or weekend work, nor is there an on-call rota
Tools provided
Company van provided
33% off at all our brands, including our hotels. Whether it’s date night at Miller & Carter or a family roast at Toby Carvery, we’ve got you covered
A pension that pays, where we’ll more than match your contributions (x1.5 of your contributions, up to a maximum of 5% of your salary)
Private healthcare, dental plan, cycle to work, and keep fit schemes
26 days annual leave plus bank holidays, plus option to buy up to 2 weeks extra holiday
Opportunity to opt in to Sharesave Plan, enabling you to save to buy shares or have money returned
What makes Mitchells & Butlers a great place to work?
To us, a career isn’t just about ‘clocking in’. We really care about our colleagues, and we’re an employer that keeps a promise. In fact, as one of the largest employers in the country, with over 44,000 people working for us, we have the responsibility of valuing every contribution from a diverse workforce that are representative of our guests, and who make us stronger. We continue to build a culture that values our differences and embraces them as strengths, and we recognise that there is always work to be done.
What you’ll need to bring to this Electrician role…
Experience as a qualified Electrician, ideally gained within the building, leisure or retail industry
Full UK driving licence
18th Edition qualification
City and Guilds level 3 Installation Electrician qualification (or equivalent)
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work on own initiative and make decisions
Ability to work to tight timescales
Although not essential, experience gained with fire alarm systems would be preferable.
Could you be a great addition to our team? Apply for this Electrician role today and we’ll be in touch to explore how you could be part of our exciting future. What makes Mitchells & Butlers a great place to work?
At M&B we value the unique perspectives each person brings. We believe that by fostering a culture of inclusion, respect, and allyship, we create a sense of belonging, engagement and teamwork which are essential to delivering great guest experiences.
Join us and be a part of a great team!
Please be aware that we reserve the right to close our vacancies earlier than the listed date if we have received a high level of applications. We would recommend that if you do wish to be considered that you complete the application as promptly as possible as interviews will be taking place whilst the advert is live. ???????

items.text:
Insight Employment is currently recruiting for our client based in Bedford
This is an exciting opportunity to work within a fast-paced manufacturing environment, where a variety of roles are available such as Canning line Operator, Counterbalance Driver and more.
We have have a number of Counterbalance Forklift permanent vacances with an immediate start. You must be able to work all 3 shift patterns, which changes weekly. Basic salary is £27,363.63 per annum + monthly shift allowance bonus of £6,684.39 per annum.
Roles & duties: –
Canning line Operator
Key responsibilities: –
Monitor conveyor belts and canning line equipment to ensure products meet quality standards.
Inspect cans and bottles for defects, reporting any issues promptly.
Maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail throughout the production process.
Operate production machinery safely and efficiently.
Carry out routine checks and basic maintenance as required.
Follow all company procedures relating to food safety, quality control, and health & safety.
Support the wider production team to achieve daily production targets.
Counterbalance Forklift Driver with double fork
Key Responsibilities: –
Operate forklifts and clamp trucks safely and efficiently, completing all required health & safety checks.
Load and unload incoming and outgoing vehicles.
Move empty containers and finished products throughout the site.
Transport materials between warehouse, canning, and production areas.
Carry out FLT gas bottle changes and gas loading when required.
Use SAP handheld devices and systems to accurately book stock in and out.
Maintain high standards of housekeeping, cleanliness, and hygiene within the work area.
Support operational activities including material handling, cleaning, and basic autonomous maintenance tasks.
Ensure equipment, tools, and materials are used correctly and report any faults, defects, or incidents promptly.
Adhere to all Quality, Food Safety, HACCP, Food Defence, and Health & Safety requirements.
Support the achievement of site productivity and performance targets.
Key Requirements: –
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
A valid, accredited Counterbalance Forklift Licence (in-date preferred; refresher training can be provided on-site).
At least 2 years’ forklift driving experience.
Proven experience operating double counterbalance forklifts (handling two pallets simultaneously).
Previous warehouse experience/canning line or with a fast-paced food production/manufacturing environment
A willingness to undertake general warehouse duties alongside forklift operations
Good physical fitness, as some manual handling and lifting may be required
The ability to stand for extended periods and undertake manual handling
A sound understanding of health & safety procedures and safe working practices.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
Excellent timekeeping and attendance record.
A reliable, hardworking, and positive attitude.
Support the achievement of site productivity and performance targets.
Working Hours: –
Hours can vary depending on the role, but are likely to be as follows: –
06:00am – 14:00pm
14:00pm – 22:00pm
22:00pm – 06:00am
Please note: Sponsorship is not available for this position.
Salary: –
Up to £34,048.02 per annum depending on the position & your experience
Benefits: –
Company pension scheme
Cycle to Work scheme
On-site gym
On-site parking
Employee discount programme
Employee mentoring programme
Health and wellbeing programme
Company events
Discounted or free food
Sick pay

items.text:
Production Blasting Operative
Location: Full time On-site Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm Pay Rate: £12.77 per hour Job Type: Short term assignment with the view of becoming permanent
About the Role
We are currently seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Production Blasting Operative to join a busy production team. This hands-on role is responsible for preparing and processing machine parts, panels, tooling, masking equipment and customer components through blasting operations, ensuring all work is completed accurately, safely and to the required quality standards.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong work ethic, a keen eye for detail and the ability to work effectively within a manufacturing environment.
Key Responsibilities
Adhere to all quality requirements and working methods
Carry out blasting of machine parts, panels and tooling to our client's requirements, ensuring deadlines are met as defined by Supervisors and Managers.
Blast customer parts in line with their requirements, following route cards, instructions, engineering drawings and guidance from Supervisors and Managers.
Immediately communicate any damage, instruction discrepancies or quantity issues to Supervisors and Managers.
Store parts and tooling safely, securely and in the correct designated locations.
Load blasting machines and trolleys, and correctly sort and store tooling and parts in accordance with supervisor instructions and company standards.
Sign route cards, verify quantities and blasted areas, and ensure all parts are free of blasting media before progressing to the next stage.
Accurately post operations, complete route card documentation and maintain full traceability through the MRP system.
Ensure customer delivery commitments are met by prioritising orders according to agreed priorities and delivery dates, as detailed on route cards or instructed by operators, supervisors or managers.
Maintain equipment and work areas to a high standard, ensuring they remain clean, organised and serviceable, with all equipment returned to its designated location.
If this role sounds of interest, please apply today and we will contact you directly to discuss your application in more detail.
Please note that no terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of a person's gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation. Every candidate will be assessed only in accordance with their merits, qualifications and ability to perform the duties of the job.

items.text:
Production Operative
Location: Milton Keynes
Salary : £28,080 per annum
Closing date : November 16, 2026
We are looking for a Production Operative to join our team at our site in Milton Keynes.
In this role, you will be responsible for processing and cutting metal bar and tube products to customer specifications, ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, and safety are maintained at all times. Working from production instructions and technical drawings, you will help ensure our customers receive materials that meet the required specifications and tolerances.
Based at our Milton Keynes facility, you will work with a range of metal products used across the aerospace, defence, and medical sectors. The site benefits from modern processing equipment, including advanced cutting technology and CNC machining centres with integrated robotics.
Previous bar saw experience is not essential, as full training can be provided. We are keen to hear from candidates with experience in production, manufacturing, engineering, warehouse, or other industrial environments who are looking to develop their skills and build a long-term career.
Shift Pattern
40 hours per week
Week 1: 6:00am - 2:00pm
Week 2: 2:00pm - 10:00pm
Alternating weekly shift pattern
This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established manufacturing business that invests in its people, equipment, and training.
Key Responsibilities
Your main duties will include:
Operating the Bar Saw to a high quality and safe standard
Ensuring we have warehouse traceability
Working from drawings you will be required to accurately set various machines and produce parts to order
Use forklifts to gather material for the jobs and record all information on job sheets
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
Essential skills and experience:
Experience working within a manufacturing, production, warehouse, or industrial environment
Ability to read basic drawings and accurately record information
Flexible and willing to support other operational tasks when required
Strong communication, organisation, and time management skills
A proactive approach with a strong focus on safety and quality
Desirable skills and experience:
Previous experience operating saws, cutting equipment, or similar machinery (training can be provided)
Forklift licence/certification
Experience working with metal products or engineering/manufacturing processes
Please note, previous bar saw experience is not essential. Full training can be provided for the right candidate, and we welcome applications from individuals with experience in production, manufacturing, warehouse, or similar operational environments.
Benefits

Annual Leave: 25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays

Company bonus scheme
Advantageous pension scheme
Learning & Development opportunities
Advanced Family Friendly Policies
Discounts portal
Employee Assistance Programme
Length of Service Awards
Christmas savings scheme
Cycle to Work Scheme
Company events
Christmas Closedown
Our Company Values
Our company values are the fundamental principles that guide our organization’s actions, culture, and decision-making processes. Our values were created by our employees across all departments in the business and with people at all levels, creating authentic values that make sense to us and demonstrate how we like to work with each other. They serve as the foundation for our company’s identity, shaping how our employees interact with one another, customers, and the broader community.

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for tk accelis, please click apply to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Cleaner and Packer, permanent (and you finish at 12 on Fridays)
Location: Milton Keynes, MK11 3HD
Salary: £ 13.50 per hour
Hours: Monday – Friday, 8am – 5pm Monday – Thursday and 8am – 12pm on Friday
Contract: Full time, Permanent
Some people walk into a room and see the mess. You walk in and see how much better it could look. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.
We’re Universal Science, a Milton Keynes manufacturer that’s been going for over 24 years. We make custom parts for customers in electronics and electric vehicles, and we’re looking for someone to help keep our workplace clean, safe and a genuinely nice place to be.
What You’ll Be Doing
Part of your day goes on keeping the place looking good: the factory floor, offices, kitchen and toilets. The rest goes on packing our finished parts carefully so they reach customers in perfect condition. You’ll be the reason the kitchen is somewhere people want to prepare their lunch, and the reason our customers open a box and think “these people know what they’re doing.” It matters, and we’ll tell you so.
Who We’re Looking For
Someone who takes pride in doing a job properly and notices the little things other people walk past. Experience is helpful but not essential, because we’ll show you everything you need to know. Whether you’re early in your working life or have plenty of years behind you, what matters is that you care about doing it well.
A Job You Can Settle Into
This is a permanent role with a steady, friendly team. It isn’t agency work and it isn’t a short-term contract.
Your Hours
8am – 5pm Monday – Thursday, and 8am – 12pm on Friday, with a 30-minute lunch and two 15-minute breaks a day. Overtime is available if you’d like it.
What You Get
22 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with three days kept for the Christmas shutdown
A discretionary bonus when the company does well
Pension that puts in 1% more than the legal minimum
Free parking, tea and coffee
Employee of the Year wins a trip abroad, and the person who keeps the whole place running has every chance of winning it
Fancy it? Send us your CV, or if you don’t have one, just get in touch and tell us a bit about yourself –
You may have experience in the following: Cleaner, Packer, Cleaner and Packer, Factory Cleaner, Industrial Cleaner, Cleaning Operative, Packing Operative, Production Packer, Warehouse Packer, Warehouse Operative, Factory Operative, Production Operative, etc.
