items.text:
Are you ready for that next step in your career? Do you thrive in a fast paced environment where teamwork rules? Have you just recently completed an apprenticeship and want to put your learning into real life practice?
Here at GXO, we are currently recruiting for a Facilities Service Engineer to join our team in Milton Keynes, supporting our two sites for our customer Waitrose. As a Facilities Service Engineer you will carry out planned mechanical preventative maintenance on cage repairs and racking repairs including reactive repairs, PPM’s and racking inspections while utilising the computerised maintenance management system (CMMS) to support the smooth running of the operation.
This is a full time, permanent position, working Monday to Friday, 07:00 till 15:00.
Pay, benefits and more:
We’re looking to offer a salary of up to £30,000.00 per annum, and 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays). Your benefits package includes, a company sponsored pension scheme, private medical & dental insurance, a 24/7 online GP service, life assurance and a fully comprehensive employee assistance programme. You’ll also have access to our MyBenefits platform offering a variety of high street discounts, a cycle to work scheme, cashback cards, a saving scheme and much more!
What you’ll do on a typical day:
Effective upkeep and performance of mechanical and equipment up to employee trained competency level
Identify and progress continuous improvement opportunities within the department and across all areas of the operation, enhancing the service to our customer
Monitor plant and mechanical equipment as necessary including use of the BMS system
Required from time to time to cover mechanical maintenance tasks at other Waitrose campus sites as part of the Waitrose Engineering Team
What you need to succeed at GXO:
Holder of 18 edition wiring is desirable however, not essential. We will support you to gain this in your first six months
Response to and reporting of incidents to ensure communication is maintained across shifts
Facilities/engineering mechanical background with an apprenticeship being advantageous
We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.
GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. GXO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate, support and thrive on diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe that diversity and inclusion in our business is critical to our success as a global company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. We are an Armed Forces friendly organisation and Disability Confident Leader as part of the Disability Confident Scheme (GIS) and actively welcome applications from people with disabilities.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. Review GXO's candidate privacy statement

Why Greencore?
Following the combination with Bakkavor in January 2026, we're one of the UK's leading creators of convenience food, driven by a simple purpose: to make every day taste better. As a vibrant and fast-moving business, we're proud to employ over 28,000 talented colleagues across 36 manufacturing sites and 21 distribution depots in the UK and the US. Together, we bring delicious food to life. Our products cover every meal occasion from breakfast through to dinner and dessert, with lunch and snacking in between. In FY25, our shared passion helped us achieve combined revenues of approximately £4bn. Our extensive direct to store (DTS) network, with 17 depots across the UK, allows us to deliver fresh and frozen food both our own and from trusted partners to thousands of stores every day, ensuring consumers enjoy the very best, whenever and wherever they shop.
Here at Northampton , we operate one of the most impressive facilities in Europe, based across a campus of 5 manufacturing units, and we have a team of around 2,000 colleagues making high quality premium products every day . We are the sole supplier of sandwiches, wraps, rolls and sushi for Marks & Spencer.

Daily machinery start-up and continuous oversight

items.text:
PRODUCTION OPERATIVE
We are looking for Production Operatives who can lead the way in delivering our customers tasty high quality Brioche products. We want to find candidates with the desire to grow and progress within the company with the support of ongoing professional training and development.
Location: Milton Keynes
Contract Type: Full Time/Permanent
Hours: All our Production Operative roles are based on working a continental shift pattern of 4 on 4 off, rotating between both day and night shifts with working hours being 06:00 to 18:00 (days) / 18:00 to 06:00 (nights). Small variations may occur depending on the production line to which you are assigned.
Starting Salary: We offer a competitive starting salary of £30,551 per annum (£14.33 per hour), incl. of night shift allowance.
Rates increasing as training progresses and assessments are complete.
Note: We are currently not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position.
Benefits (subject to length of service): •
Company Pension Plan (with 7% company investment) •
Westfield Health Plan (reclaim some basic healthcare costs) •
Company Sick Pay and Income Protection Plan •
Life Assurance.
About the Role: •
Monitor, control and manage baking machines and equipment. •
Monitor the smooth running of the work area processes. •
Perform and record regular quality checks to deadline. •
Participate in the cleaning of the production machines and equipment. •
Work to high standards of health & safety and Food safety measures.
About You: •
Have a flexible ‘can do’ approach to the work you do •
Enjoy working and contributing to a team •
Have a keen eye for detail •
A willingness to learn and develop •
Some experience working in a busy food production position would be an advantage, but full training will be given for the right person.
This is your opportunity to work for one of the largest food manufactures in Europe, Brioche Pasquier. We have been present in the UK for over 2 decades and sell a range of French bakery products to major UK food retailers, wholesale and food service markets. The company is still family run and has a culture reflective of the closeness and respect this brings with a history reaching back to 1936. We are still a growing international company with a strong manufacturing presence in Europe, South Korea and USA and products presence in over 50 other countries.
We are at our 240,000 sq. ft. technologically advanced production facility to service the UK market in order to continue the strong growth of the company.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a category-leading brand and an exciting stage in the history of the business.

Pay: £13.50 per hour
Job Description:
Hours:
Monday to Friday
7am to 5pm
Overview
We are currently recruiting for a Production Operative to join a busy manufacturing environment. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys practical work, takes pride in producing quality products and is looking to build a long-term career with opportunities to develop and progress.
The role is based within a busy industrial manufacturing environment , so candidates should be comfortable working in conditions that can be noisy, dusty and dirty . The position involves regular physical activity, working around production machinery and handling manufactured products.
The Role
Setting up and operating production machinery and equipment
Removing finished products from moulds
Finishing and tidying manufactured products to the required standard
Carrying out visual quality checks and reporting any issues
Moving materials and finished products around the production area
Working to daily production targets and quality standards
Following all health & safety procedures and site rules
Keeping the working area clean, safe and organised
Working effectively as part of a team while also using your own initiative
Supporting other areas of production when required
About You
We are looking for someone who is hard-working, reliable and genuinely interested in developing their skills and progressing within a manufacturing environment.
The successful candidate will:
Have a strong work ethic and a conscientious approach
Be comfortable working in a noisy, dusty and physically demanding environment
Be able to work at pace and under pressure
Have good communication and organisational skills
Be able to work towards targets and maintain high quality standards
Have good time management and attention to detail
Be flexible and willing to learn new skills
Be a positive team player who can also work independently
Have a desire to develop, take on additional responsibility and progress within the business
Desirable Experience but not essential
The following experience would be advantageous, although training may be available for the right candidate:
Previous experience within manufacturing, production or a similar industrial environment
Counterbalance forklift experience/licence
Experience operating overhead gantry cranes
First Aid qualification
What’s on Offer
Competitive rate of pay
Full training and ongoing development
Opportunities to learn additional skills and progress within the business
Contributory pension scheme
Employee assistance programme
Employee savings scheme
£500 Refer a Friend scheme, payable to both the successful new starter and referring employee
A long-term opportunity within an established and growing manufacturing environment

Support barcode scanning and inventory management improvements.
Provide administration support covering goods in and goods out functions as required.
Previous experience working within a manufacturing, production, engineering, assembly, or industrial environment .
Experience in stock control, inventory management, warehouse administration, or production administration.
Strong understanding of production processes and inventory accuracy.

Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

Experience using ERP, MRP, WMS, or inventory management systems.

items.text:
Job Title - Workshop Engineer
Location - Wellingborough, Northamptonshire
Salary: £32,000 - £42,500 (Salary DOE)
Shift: Monday to Friday - Days Shift.
Job Role:
We’re looking for an experienced Workshop Engineer to join a growing business specialising in Forklift Trucks (FLTs), Mobile Plant and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) .
Working from a fully equipped workshop, you’ll be responsible for diagnosing faults, servicing equipment and carrying out mechanical, electrical and hydraulic repairs across a varied range of machinery. This is a hands-on role suited to an engineer with strong practical skills and experience maintaining, repairing and refurbishing equipment to a high standard.
Sector - Workshop Engineering
Non-Negotiable Requirements of Workshop Engineer:
Hands-on engineering experience in a workshop or industrial engineering environment.
Requirements of Workshop Engineer:
Maintenance experience of Forklift Trucks or Mobile Plant Machinery or HGV's or industrial Vehicles.
Have hands-on experience in the following disciplines: Electrical, Mechanical and Hydraulics.
Recognised Engineering Qualification.
Desirable Requirements of Workshop Engineer.
Engineering qualification of minimum Level 3.
The Workshop Engineer will benefit from:
Training and Development
People focussed business - look after staff well.
Regular overtime opportunities
Company Benefits package
If you are interested in this role and feel that you have the right skills, then please click apply at the bottom of this advert.
For further details contact Matthew Lye at Pioneer Selection
As a registered candidate with Pioneer Selection Ltd, you automatically become eligible for our referral scheme.
You will receive £250 for every candidate we place in permanent employment who has been recommended by you. Terms and Conditions apply please see our website for further details.

You will support the engineering team in maintaining a wide range of production equipment and site facilities, helping to ensure machinery operates safely and efficiently. Training Apprenticeships include time away from working for specialist training. You’ll study to gain professional knowledge and skills. Training provider ENGINEERING TRUST TRAINING LIMITED Training course Engineering maintenance technician - single discipline (level 3) Understanding apprenticeship levels (opens in new tab) What you'll learn Course contents Review and use information. items.text:
Hue Recruitment is currently recruiting for Warehouse / Production Operators to join an established packaging manufacturing business in Olney.
This is a hands-on position working within a busy production and warehouse environment , supporting the manufacturing process from preparing raw materials through to packing and preparing finished products for dispatch.
The role would suit someone who is reliable, physically capable and looking for a long-term opportunity with the potential to become permanent.
The Role
Your responsibilities will include:
Stripping and preparing packaging materials for production
Feeding materials into production machinery
Operating and assisting with packaging machinery
Removing finished products from machinery
Packing, stacking and preparing finished products for dispatch
Moving raw materials and finished stock around the factory
Carrying out basic quality checks on finished products
Manual handling and general warehouse duties
Supporting the production team to maintain an efficient workflow
Keeping production and warehouse areas clean, organised and safe
Following production instructions and Health & Safety procedures
Requirements
Previous experience in a warehouse, factory, manufacturing, packaging or production environment would be advantageous
Comfortable carrying out manual handling and physically active duties
Reliable, punctual and hardworking
Able to follow instructions and work safely around machinery
Good attention to detail, particularly when carrying out quality checks
Able to work effectively as part of a team
Positive attitude and willingness to learn
Hours & Benefits
Monday to Friday, 8:00am–4:30pm
Day shifts
No weekend working
Full-time, temporary-to-permanent opportunity
Modern working premises
On-site parking
Christmas closure
Holiday entitlement
Pension
Apply Now
If you are looking for a long-term Warehouse / Production opportunity within an established manufacturing environment, we would be pleased to hear from you.
Hue Recruitment Ltd is an independent recruitment consultancy specialising in temporary, temporary-to-permanent and permanent placements. We pride ourselves on matching the right candidates with the right opportunities and providing a professional, people-focused service throughout the recruitment process.

items.text:
Accounts and Purchasing Administrator
Milton Keynes
Salary: circa £30,000 per annum
Hours 8.30 -5pm
Free Parking
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established and successful international organisation for an Accounts, Purchasing Administrator to join their busy team in Milton Keynes.
This varied role will support the Accounts, Purchasing and Administration functions, ensuring the smooth running of financial processes while providing administrative support across multiple departments. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a hands-on role and thrives in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and attention to detail are essential.
Reporting to the Accounts, Purchasing and Administration Supervisor, you will be responsible for supporting accounts payable, purchasing activities and general office administration.
Accounts Payable & Finance
Processing and coding supplier invoices
Posting vouchers and payment transactions within the ERP system
Managing Accounts Payable ledgers and reconciliations
Processing employee expenses through Concur and manual systems
Creating Accounts Payable payment runs
Performing vendor statement reconciliations
Investigating and reconciling freight invoices
Supporting General Ledger reconciliations
Producing cash requirement reports
Maintaining supplier records and vendor spreadsheets
Recording Postponed VAT Accounting transactions
Purchasing
Raising and issuing purchase orders
Monitoring goods receipt and supplier invoices
Supporting supplier management and maintaining competitive pricing
Conducting supplier research and price comparisons
Carrying out regular pricing reviews
Ensuring purchasing procedures are maintained and updated
Administration
Reviewing credit applications
Managing petty cash and month-end reporting
Providing reception cover, including answering calls and welcoming visitors
Maintaining filing systems and company records
Coordinating travel, accommodation and visitor arrangements
Supporting trade show administration and expenditure tracking
Monitoring and distributing marketing materials
Providing general administrative support across departments
Supporting Accounts Receivable and wider administration teams when required
To be successful in this role, you will have:
Previous Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Purchasing experience ideally
Strong administration and organisational skills
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
Strong numerical and analytical abilities
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
Experience working with ERP or finance systems
Ability to work with both manual and semi-automated processes
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
Self-motivated with a proactive approach
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to use initiative
Comfortable working independently and as part of a small team
Professional, confident and personable manner
Able to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure
Highly organised with strong planning skills
Flexible approach to supporting business needs
Full driving licence preferred
If you're looking for a varied position that combines accounts, purchasing and administration , and you enjoy working in a collaborative environment where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

4Recruitment Services are seeking a Retirement Housing Facilities Assistant for our clientbased in Luton.
Our client provides retirement housing for people over the age of 55. You will be required to manage the maintenance and security of the buildings, monitor contracts and services and provide a focused facilities management service to residents living in the clients properties.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:
To be a key-holder for the building and ensure security of the communal areas and facilities
To be the first point of contact and manage access to the building for residents, contractors and visitors
Meet contractors on site and facilitate access to communal areas to carry out repairs, planned maintenance and servicing of facilities and plant equipment
Allow access to utility companies for essential maintenance and servicing of equipment
Manage and monitor the laundry facilities & communal areas
Monitor and facilitate resolution of complaints relating to communal areas and facilities
Monitor cleaning staff to ensure the property conditions are maintained and provide a welcoming environment
Monitor and advise tenants on the management of their rent accounts and arrears
Carry out regular inspections of the building to identify and resolve repair, maintenance and security issues
Raise repairs, facilitate access and guidance to the affected areas for contractors
Complete water testing in communal areas
Carry out testing of communal emergency lighting and fire fighting equipment in line with the associations health and safety processes
Ensure that all actions identified in the fire risk assessment for the service are completed and access to the building is co-ordinated with the contractors
Manage or provide gritting at the property in line with the service gritting plan as required
Carry out health and safety inspections of the building and record the outcomes in line with service standards
Monitoring accidents, incidents and near misses in line with the clients health and safety procedures
ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS INCLUDE:
Facilities management experience
Excellent customer services skills
Overall knowledge and experience of working with older people, and/or general public and service providers in a service based role
Self motivated with the ability to prioritise your workload whilst being adaptable to the needs of the residents or service requirements
Knowledge and understanding of the housing/building management sector
Understanding or experience of health and safety issues and management
Recruitment is done in line with safe recruitment practices. 4Recruitment Services is an equal opportunities employer.

What you'll do at work About the Role Are you curious about how engineered products are designed and manufactured? At Ram Power, we're looking for an ambitious and motivated apprentice to join our specialist engineering team. This is much more than an apprenticeship - it's an opportunity to build a long-term career within a growing manufacturing business. You'll gain a unique understanding of the entire manufacturing process, from engineering drawings and production planning through to assembly, inspection and testing. Working alongside experienced engineers and technicians, you'll develop practical knowledge, technical skills and real workplace experience that will set you up for a successful future in engineering. This role combines hands-on manufacturing experience with technical and organisational engineering support, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both practical problem-solving and working with technology. What We're Looking For We're far more interested in your attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn than previous experience. We're looking for someone with a genuine interest in engineering and manufacturing who enjoys understanding how things work and how products are made. Unlike many larger manufacturers, you'll see products progress from design through manufacture, assembly, testing and final inspection, giving you a broad understanding of engineering and manufacturing. We are not a mass-production factory. We work on complex, low-volume engineering projects, including defence, where our team has to think, solve problems and understand exactly how and why a product is being made. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys practical work, solving problems and learning how things are made. Your duties will include: Mechanical fitting and assembly of hydraulic cylinders and components Learning how hydraulic systems and specialist equipment operate Reading and interpreting engineering drawings Using hand tools, measuring equipment and workshop machinery safely Measuring and inspecting manufactured components Assisting with hydraulic assembly, testing and quality checks Learning about seals, bearings, engineering materials and components Following safe working practices and workshop procedures Supporting fault-finding and problem-solving activities Completing quality documentation and manufacturing records • Gaining exposure to machining processes including turning and milling Working as part of a skilled engineering team to deliver high-quality products You won't be expected to know everything from day one. We are looking for someone with enthusiasm, curiosity and a genuine interest in engineering. We're looking for someone who is reliable, motivated to learn, and willing to take responsibility as their skills develop. The ability to follow instructions carefully, work safely, and maintain a high standard of work is essential. items.text:
Casual Assembly Worker, flexible hours
Location: Milton Keynes, MK11 3HD
Salary: £13.50 per hour
Hours: Casual, daytime hours (flexible)
Contract: Part time, Fixed Term Contract
Do you have steady hands, a good eye and a bit of patience? We’ve got some satisfying, fiddly work that needs someone who likes getting things just right.
We’re Universal Science, a Milton Keynes manufacturer that’s been going for over 24 years. We make custom parts for customers in electronics, electric vehicles and motorsport. We need someone to join us on a casual basis to apply specialist tape to trays for one of our customers. It’s precise work, and when it’s done well, it looks brilliant.
How It Works
When the work comes in, we’ll offer you shifts, and you’re free to say yes or no. Work happens within our normal hours of 8am – 5pm Monday – Thursday and 8am – 12pm on Friday, so you’ll be home for tea and finished by Friday lunchtime. It could suit someone looking for extra income, flexible hours or something that fits around other commitments.
Who We’re Looking For
Someone careful, reliable and happy to take their time to get it right. You don’t need experience, because we’ll show you exactly what to do. If you’ve done assembly, packing, crafts or anything else that needs nimble fingers, you’ll probably love it.
What You Get
£13.50 an hour plus holiday pay
Free parking
Free tea and coffee
A friendly team who’ll be very pleased to see you
We could even consider home working for the right person
Fancy it? Send us your CV, or if you don’t have one, just get in touch and tell us a bit about yourself –
You may have experience in the following: Assembly Worker, Casual Assembly Worker, Assembly Operative, Production Operative, Production Assistant, Packer, Production Packer, Factory Operative, Light Industrial Operative, Manufacturing Operative, Temporary Assembler, Part Time Assembler, etc.

Contract Type: Permanent - Fulltime
Shift Pattern/ Time: Wednesday to Sunday, 22:00 - 06:30
Rate: £16.14 p/h
Location: Greencore Northampton 15-17 Deer Park Road, NN3 6RX
(Please note this is a FULL-TIME role only)
Why Greencore?
Following the combination with Bakkavor in January 2026, we're one of the UK's leading creators of convenience food, driven by a simple purpose: to make every day taste better. As a vibrant and fast-moving business, we're proud to employ over 28,000 talented colleagues across 36 manufacturing sites and 21 distribution depots in the UK and the US. Together, we bring delicious food to life. Our products cover every meal occasion from breakfast through to dinner and dessert, with lunch and snacking in between. In FY25, our shared passion helped us achieve combined revenues of approximately £4bn. Our extensive direct to store (DTS) network, with 17 depots across the UK, allows us to deliver fresh and frozen food both our own and from trusted partners to thousands of stores every day, ensuring consumers enjoy the very best, whenever and wherever they shop.
Here at Northampton , we operate one of the most impressive facilities in Europe, based across a campus of 5 manufacturing units, and we have a team of around 2,000 colleagues making high quality premium products every day . We are the sole supplier of sandwiches, wraps, rolls and sushi for Marks & Spencer.
What you'll be doing
Daily machinery start-up and continuous oversight
Reporting machinery faults as necessary
Ensuring correct label usage to maintain high standards
Regular completion of compliance checks, including date and code verification
Adherence to compliance controls, risk assessments, and Safe Systems of Work (SSOW)
Ensuring a safe working environment for colleagues and oneself
Performing relevant quality checks and promptly addressing quality or food safety issues
Collaboration within a close-knit production team
What we're looking for
Good numeracy and English Language skills both verbal and written
Can demonstrate working in a safe manner and do good H&S practices
Accurate and pays attention to detail Ability to work well under pressure.
Knowledge of and or experience of working in a FMCG/Warehouse would be advantageous, though full training is provided.
At Greencore we put our people at the core. We celebrate their differences and help everyone to be themselves at work. Together we make every day taste better. If this sounds like you, join us and grow with Greencore, and be a part of driving our future success.
What you'll get in return
Competitive salary and job-related benefits
Holidays
Competitive matched pension contributions
Life insurance up to 4x salary
Company share save scheme
Greencore Qualifications
Exclusive Greencore employee discount platform
Access to a full Wellbeing Centre platform
Throughout your time at Greencore, you will be supported with on the job training and development opportunities to further your career.
Greencore and its recruitment partners never charge candidates any fees at any stage of the hiring process. Any request for payment relating to a job opportunity should be considered fraudulent.

items.text:
Unlock your Potential
with a Trescal Apprenticeship
If you are looking to develop a career in the engineering sector, gain new skills and work for a growing and diverse global company that offers flexible working, then this role is for you .
Trescal is the global independent expert in calibration services. Each year, companies active in the aerospace, automotive, pharmaceutical, chemical, energy, electronics and telecommunication sectors entrust Trescal with their calibration needs.
We have an exciting opportunity for you to be part of our Apprentice programme, which is available across all of our main UK sites.
You will be trained to calibrate and optimise a wide range of measuring instrumentation and learn to fault find and repair equipment You will be required to perform in accordance with our Quality System and Company Procedures that are internally & externally audited to ISO9001 and ISO17025 by BSI and UKAS.
This 4 year programme will include:
NVQ Level 3 & BTEC Diploma Level 3 (Level 7 Scotland) in Engineering
Calibration Fundamentals
In house training rotating across various calibration disciplines e.g. pressure, temperature, electrical, in UKAS accredited laboratories
Personal development courses with external training provider
Microsoft software packages
Future Prospects
Upon completion of your Apprenticeship, you will be a qualified Calibration Engineer and hold UKAS signatory status. Your further development will move you to a Senior Engineer, Technical Lead, Technical Specialist or a Management role. There is also the opportunity to further develop your formal qualifications.
Minimum of 5 GCSE's including English and Maths at grade 4 or higher or in Scotland National 5 grade A-C in English, Math and Science
PC literacy and knowledge of Microsoft software
Proactive approach to learning and problem-solving
Good interpersonal and communication skills
Ability to attend college weekly in term time

This is not a traditional engineering role. Instead, you will focus on keeping existing electrical equipment and systems working well, improving them where needed, and making sure they meet safety and compliance requirements. You will work with experienced engineers who maintain and improve electrical infrastructure across AWE. This could include power supplies, lighting, alarms, monitoring systems and other equipment that supports our work. You will learn how engineers make sure electrical systems are safe, reliable, ready to use and fit for the future. You will also see how engineering decisions are made in a highly regulated environment, where safety, quality and following the right processes are extremely important. During the programme, you will build practical experience in areas such as: Electrical engineering Asset lifecycle management Reliability improvement Fault investigation Engineering change Electrical safety Plant performance monitoring Regulatory compliance Electrical cable calculations As an Electrical Engineer (Facilities & Equipment) at AWE, you may work with equipment and systems such as: HV and LV switchgear and distribution. Sales Administrator - Dunstable
We are working with an industry leading provider in Dunstable who are renowned for supplying products and services that you'd see on TV and at some of the largest events in the UK. We are looking to speak with experienced Sales Administrators, who have strong working knowledge of processing orders and more importantly raising invoices.
In this role you'd be 100% focussed on supporting the team with invoices, PO's and quotation support - So you'd be spending a lot of time on the system working through all documentation linked to orders and projects but equally you'd need to be speaking to project managers, clients, engineers etc. where required.
This is going to be an ideal role for someone with previous office experience, ideally, we're looking for someone with good communication and people skills, but more inportantly the successful candidate will come with strong orders processing or invoicing experience.
You'd be joining a well-established company and a high-functioning team of very kind, supportive and fun people with a real work hard, play hard attitude.
This is a temporary position to start, with a view to this role going Permenant towards the end of this year. You'd be earning a salary of £28k which would be weekly pay at an hourly rate of £14.56 per hour (+ holiday pay accrual).
Hybrid working is on offer here as standard and you'd be doing so from week 2, working 3 days in the offices in Dunstable and 2 days from home weekly (Usually Mon-Weds in the offices and Thurs/Fri WFH).
The team operate Monday to Friday, 8.30am to 5pm with an hour's lunch break.
What to expect day-to-day:
Generating and processing up to approximately 200 invoices, POs and other order documents per month.
Running weekly reports to help your team track project timeframes and targets.
Quote building - Lots of admin/data input to create quotes whilst speaking to customers
Candidate Skills:
Some form of previous office experience is essential, particularly dealing with invoicing, processing orders, raising POs or similar.
Communication skills are very important in this role, working alongside internal contacts and communication with project managers, engineers and customers in the field.
Must be comfortable with working from home a few times a week and have a good wifi connection and dedicated work space.
The ability to work with your own initiative.
Multitasking, juggling and managing your own workload.
A positive and can-do outlook and approach.
A team player.
We are currently recruiting for this role and looking for candidates that we can interview for the role ASAP, so do not hesitate to get in touch with Ryan by applying.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing, and IT Helpdesk/IT support.

items.title: Assistant Clerk & Finance Administrator
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Assistant Clerk & Finance Administrator
Location: MK10 (Home-based with travel within the Parish; hybrid working once offices open).
Salary : SCP (13 - 17) (£30,023 to £32,046 per annum pro-rata)
Hours of Work: 25-30 hours per week with a requirement for some evening work to attend Council meetings and events
Supporting Kents Hill & Monkston as it grows and evolves.
Kents Hill & Monkston Parish Council is strengthening its operational capacity as responsibilities expand and expectations rise across the parish. With new community facilities coming online, increasing service demands and a commitment to modern, responsive governance, we are investing in the capability needed for the future.
We are looking for an Assistant Clerk & Finance Administrator who can play a key role in the Council’s day to day management. Working closely with the Parish Clerk & RFO, you will help ensure the Council’s finances, governance arrangements and operational services are delivered effectively, accurately and transparently.
About the role
This is a varied and responsible role at the heart of the Council's operations. A significant part of the role will involve ownership of the Council's day-to-day financial administration, ensuring robust financial processes and accurate record keeping.
You will manage invoice processing, payments, financial records, VAT submissions and audit administration, working closely with the Clerk & RFO to ensure the Council maintains strong financial controls and compliance.
Alongside financial administration, you will support governance and democratic processes, preparing agendas, reports and minutes, maintaining records and supporting compliance with statutory requirements and Council policies.
You will also help deliver practical improvements across the parish, coordinate contractors, support environmental and community projects, and help ensure community assets and facilities remain safe, compliant and well maintained.
As the Council takes on new facilities and responsibilities, you will play a key role in developing effective systems and processes, supporting service delivery and providing organisational resilience, including deputising for the Clerk where appropriate.
About you
To succeed, you will bring:
Experience in finance administration, bookkeeping, accounts processing or a similar financial role.
Confidence managing invoices, payments, financial records and administrative financial processes with a high level of accuracy.
Experience in operations, administration or service delivery within a public-facing or regulated environment.
Strong organisational skills, accuracy and the ability to manage competing priorities
Confidence coordinating contractors, managing tasks and supporting practical, on-the-ground work
Clear communication skills and a professional, customer-focused approach when working with residents, councillors and stakeholders.
A commitment to public service, community wellbeing and continuous improvement
Experience in a local council environment is helpful but not essential. We are particularly interested in candidates with good finance and administration experience who are looking to broaden their responsibilities within a professional, community focused organisation.
How to apply
Please click apply, submit your details and a member from our recruitment partner CHRGS will send you a candidate pack.
Closing date: Applications must be returned by 12pm, 5 November 2026
Interviews: w/c 16 November 2026

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Are you a Trainee Engineer or Technical Machine Operator looking to gain hands-on engineering experience in a fast-paced FMCG factory environment. This Junior Maintenance Engineer role offers structured training, a supportive working culture, and a shift pattern that helps you balance life outside of work. If you enjoy problem-solving, want to build practical skills, and are motivated to progress, this Junior Maintenance Engineer opportunity could be your next smart step.
Shift Pattern- 4 on 4 off Days & Nights
What You Will Do:
- Help deliver scheduled preventative maintenance to keep production running smoothly and safely.
- Respond quickly to breakdowns in designated areas, identifying likely causes and suggesting improvements to reduce repeat issues.
- Communicate effectively with the Engineering Shift Manager or Principal Engineer and work with operations to minimise disruption.
- Follow engineering standards and maintain strong hygiene practices in a high-compliance manufacturing setting.
- Support timely reporting of Health and Safety, Animal Welfare, and Environmental issues as required.
- Raise stock and non-stock request forms to support maintenance activities and continuous improvement.
What You Will Bring:
- Machine minder or technical operator experience, or practical exposure to factory environments.
- A strong desire to develop into engineering, with a clear motivation to learn and take on new responsibilities as a Junior Maintenance Engineer.
- Numerical and reasoning ability suitable for entry-level technical apprenticeship requirements, including Functional Skills Level 2 in Literacy and Numeracy and a pass in the Technical Abilities Test.
- Confidence working in an environment where safe working practices and attention to detail matter every shift.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team, with good communication skills and a positive attitude.
This Junior Maintenance Engineer role sits within a major food production supply chain, supporting reliable manufacturing for short shelf-life products where hygiene standards are critical. By keeping machinery in excellent condition, contributing to safe maintenance practices, and supporting continuous improvement, you directly help production teams meet performance expectations while upholding high standards across the site.
Location:
The Junior Maintenance Engineer role is based in Brackley.
Interested?:
Think this sounds like the right next move for a Junior Maintenance Engineer? Apply today and take the first step towards a secure career with training, progression, and real day-to-day engineering impact.
Your CV will be forwarded to Jonathan Lee Recruitment, a leading engineering and manufacturing recruitment consultancy established in 1978. The services advertised by Jonathan Lee Recruitment are those of an Employment Agency. In order for your CV to be processed effectively, please ensure your name, email address, phone number and location (post code OR town OR county, as a minimum) are included.

items.text:
Now recruiting for an Orders Administrator to join an industry leading provider in Dunstable who are renowned for supplying products and services that you'd see on TV and at some of the largest events in the UK.
In this role you'd be 100% focussed on supporting the team with invoices, PO's and quotation support - So you'd be spending a lot of time on the system working through all documentation linked to orders and projects but equally you'd need to be speaking to project managers, clients, engineers etc. where required.
This is going to be an ideal role for someone with previous office experience, ideally, we're looking for someone with good communication and people skills, and we need this person to come with some form of relevant orders processing or invoicing experience.
You'd be joining a well-established company and a high-functioning team of very kind, supportive and fun people with a real work hard, play hard attitude.
This is a temporary position to start, you'd be earning a salary of £28k which would be weekly pay at an hourly rate of £14.56 per hour (+ holiday pay accrual) - With a view to this going temp to perm for the right person down the line.
Hybrid working is on offer here as standard and you'd be doing so from week 2, working 3 days in the offices in Dunstable and 2 days from home weekly (Usually Mon-Weds in the offices and Thurs/Fri WFH).
The team operate Monday to Friday, 8.30am to 5pm with an hour's lunch break.
What to expect day-to-day:
Generating and processing up to approximately 200 invoices, POs and other order documents per month.
Running weekly reports to help your team track project timeframes and targets.
Quote building - Lots of admin/data input to create quotes whilst speaking to customers
Candidate Skills:
Some form of previous office experience is essential, particularly dealing with invoicing, processing orders, raising POs or similar.
Communication skills are very important in this role, working alongside internal contacts and communication with project managers, engineers and customers in the field.
Must be comfortable with working from home a few times a week and have a good wifi connection and dedicated work space.
The ability to work with your own initiative.
Multitasking, juggling and managing your own workload.
A positive and can-do outlook and approach.
A team player.
We are currently recruiting for this role and looking for candidates that we can interview for the role ASAP, so do not hesitate to get in touch with Bobby by applying.

We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing, and IT Helpdesk/IT support.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Reports to: Branch Manager / Area Operations Manager Location: Bedford Department: Customer Service / Operations
Our Client is looking for an experienced customer Service Advisor to join their growing team. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service, enjoy building strong customer relationships, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.
As part of our ambitious growth strategy, our goal is to triple the number of repeat customers over the next five years . This role is central to achieving that ambition by ensuring every customer receives outstanding service, expert support, and a seamless experience from enquiry through to order fulfilment.
As a Customer Service Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, providing a friendly, professional, and efficient service across a broad range of products. You'll process customer orders, manage enquiries, resolve issues, and work closely with colleagues across the business to deliver an outstanding customer experience.
This is a varied role that combines customer service, sales support, administration, and operational collaboration, making it ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership and making a real difference.
Deliver outstanding customer service across phone, email, and other communication channels.
Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring prompt fulfilment.
Handle customer enquiries and provide product guidance and recommendations.
Escalate technical product enquiries to specialist teams where appropriate.
Resolve customer issues and complaints professionally, achieving positive outcomes.
Liaise with internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure smooth order processing.
Follow up quotations and proactively engage with customers.
Identify and communicate sales opportunities to the External Sales Team.
Support branch operations, including warehouse or trade counter activities when required.
Participate in stock cycle counting.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
Support the wider branch team and undertake additional duties as required.
We're looking for someone who enjoys helping customers, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and works well as part of a team.
You'll ideally have:
Previous experience in a customer service, sales support, or internal sales role.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail.
The ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
A proactive approach to problem solving and customer service.
Experience using ERP or order processing systems (desirable).
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
A willingness to develop product knowledge and learn about our industry.
In this role, you'll help ensure:
Customers receive consistently outstanding service.
Orders are processed accurately and efficiently.
Customer enquiries and complaints are resolved quickly and professionally.
Strong customer relationships are developed and maintained.
Sales opportunities are identified and passed to the relevant teams.
The branch achieves improvements in customer retention, sales growth, and operational performance.
You make a positive contribution to our team culture and business success.
You'll become part of a supportive team where your contribution is recognised, your ideas are valued, and you'll have opportunities to develop your skills and progress your career. Every day brings new challenges, and you'll play an important role in helping us achieve our ambitious growth plans while delivering an exceptional experience for our customers.
Ready to join us?
Apply today and become part of a business that's committed to putting customers first and building lasting relationships.
Please note that at times due to the volume of applications we may not be able to respond to each person individually. If you do not hear from us within 7 days we’re sorry you have not been successful this time. Please do not let this stop you applying for other positions you may be suitable for. Good Luck! 1st Choice Staff Recruitment is an equal opportunities employer and acts as both an Employment Agency & Business.

items.text:
Shift Pattern: Friday to Tuesday, 22:00 - 06:30
Pay Rate: £17.29 Per Hour
Why Greencore?
Following the combination with Bakkavor in January 2026, we're one of the UK's leading creators of convenience food, driven by a simple purpose: to make every day taste better. As a vibrant and fast-moving business, we're proud to employ over 28,000 talented colleagues across 36 manufacturing sites and 21 distribution depots in the UK and the US. Together, we bring delicious food to life. Our products cover every meal occasion from breakfast through to dinner and dessert, with lunch and snacking in between. In FY25, our shared passion helped us achieve combined revenues of approximately £4bn. Our extensive direct to store (DTS) network, with 17 depots across the UK, allows us to deliver fresh and frozen food both our own and from trusted partners to thousands of stores every day, ensuring consumers enjoy the very best, whenever and wherever they shop.
Here at Northampton , we operate one of the most impressive facilities in Europe, based across a campus of 5 manufacturing units, and we have a team of around 2,000 colleagues making high quality premium products every day . We are the sole supplier of sandwiches, wraps, rolls and sushi for Marks & Spencer.
What you'll be doing
To ensure that all equipment on the line is operated correctly and efficiently, whilst carrying out appropriate frontline maintenance to maintain and improve the equipment performance and maximise product output whilst maintaining product quality.
Setting up and maintaining the machines at the beginning of the product and throughout.
Ensure the machines run to optimum efficiency by investigating downtime and ensuring corrective action is implemented through SIC (Short Interval Control) reviews and PPM Systems.
Proactively identify and resolve any issues with the machines to ensure they are resolved in a timely manner.
Endeavour to keep waste levels to an absolute minimum and continuously work to reduce these levels.
Overseeing line activity, by ensuring all aspects of the line are running at the correct pace.
Carryout paperwork for the machinery to ensure Health and Safety measurements are adhered to.
Cleaning and maintaining machinery and work areas to be at a high standard at all times.
You must have full understanding of the sites Food Safety, HACCP, QA and Hygiene Standards whilst also carrying out safety checks or risk assessments when required.
Understand the customer standards and specifications for each product to ensure the line minimises any complaints or rejections by maintaining the quality of product and packaging at all times.
Maintain a constant understanding of changes and adaptations made to the equipment or machinery on the line. Ensure any changes are cascaded to individuals in the team where appropriate
What we're looking for
Prior experience working with machinery
Strong knowledge of a heavy duty and high-speed machinery.
Strong ability to use measurement tools.
Good understanding of production procedures and best practices.
Excellent knowledge of safety methods and hazard regulations.
Ability to read manuals, blueprints, and handbooks.
Good physical stamina and keen attention to detail
We're not all the same at Greencore and our differences help us to make every day taste better for all our stakeholders. We truly put our people at the core and are proud of our diversity.
What you'll get in return
Competitive salary and job-related benefits
Holidays
Competitive matched pension contributions
Life insurance up to 4x salary
Company share save scheme
Greencore Qualifications
Exclusive Greencore employee discount platform
Access to a full Wellbeing Centre platform
Throughout your time at Greencore, you will be supported with on the job training and development opportunities to further your career.

items.text:
Production Operative - Full Training Provided
Brackley | £26,000 - £30,000 DOE + Overtime | Permanent | Full-time
We're recruiting for an established and growing production business in Brackley, looking for Production Operatives to join a busy and friendly team.
Whether you already have experience in manufacturing, production or machine operation, or you're looking for an opportunity to learn something completely new, we'd love to hear from you.
You'll be trained to operate specialist semi-automated machinery used in textile production and finishing. No experience with this particular equipment is required, as full training will be provided.
What matters most is your attitude, reliability, attention to detail and willingness to get stuck in!
What you'll be doing
Learning to operate semi-automated textile finishing and stitching machines
Reading and following job sheets and production instructions
Handling and guiding fabrics through the finishing process
Trimming and finishing materials
Quality checking completed work
Folding and packing finished products
Working accurately and efficiently to production deadlines
Working as part of a busy and supportive production team
What we're looking for
Previous experience within production, manufacturing, textiles, fabrics, print finishing or machine operation would be useful, but it's certainly not essential.
More importantly, you'll be:
Reliable, hardworking and keen to learn
Practical and comfortable in a hands-on working environment
Accurate with good attention to detail
Able to follow instructions and job sheets
Comfortable working at pace and to deadlines
Proactive, adaptable and a good team player
Someone who takes pride in the quality of their work
What's on offer
£22,000 - £30,000 depending on experience
Overtime opportunities
Full training on the machinery and processes
Opportunity to learn new skills and develop within the business
Permanent, full-time position
Established and forward-thinking working environment
The salary range reflects the fact that we're genuinely open-minded about experience. You could be starting out and looking for an opportunity to learn, or already have relevant production, textile or machine-operating experience and be able to bring more to the role from day one.
If you're reliable, practical and looking for a long-term opportunity where you can learn, develop and become part of a busy production team, we'd love to hear from you
Whether you're a school leaver looking for your first opportunity or an experienced Machine Operative looking for your next move, we'd be equally happy to hear from you.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
About the opportunity
CES is a consultancy specialising in the inspection and repair of buildings, civil structures and services affected by corrosion. We are looking for an organised, approachable and confident person to support the day-to-day running of our business. This is a varied role within a small team, with room to take initiative, improve how things are organised and learn new skills.
The work combines everyday business administration, managing compliance records and financial record-keeping. You do not need to be a qualified bookkeeper or compliance specialist. We have external accountants and technical staff to advise on specialist matters. We want someone who can understand requests, find the right information, ask sensible questions and follow tasks through.
What you will do
General Business Administration
Arrange staff travel, accommodation and other business requirements.
Manage routine correspondence, client enquiries and office administration.
Coordinate company insurance, memberships and subscription renewals.
Provide general administrative support to directors and colleagues.
Company Accreditations and Compliance Administration
Complete online questionnaires and supplier accreditation applications, including CHAS and SafeContractor.
Gather supporting documents and information from colleagues.
Maintain organised records of company certificates, policies and supporting evidence.
Monitor renewal dates and ensure applications are completed and submitted on time.
Liaise with accreditation providers to resolve routine queries.
Staff and Training Administration
Maintain employee records and assist with routine HR administration.
Maintain staff training and competency records.
Monitor training and certification expiry dates.
Arrange training courses and renewals as required.
Support new-starter and leaver administration using established procedures.
Financial Administration
Maintain day-to-day financial records using Xero accounting software.
Process purchase invoices, sales invoices and staff expenses.
Undertake bank reconciliations and maintain accurate financial records.
Monitor outstanding invoices and assist with credit control.
Prepare payment information for director approval.
Liaise with external accountants and prepare routine payroll information.
Organisation and Process Coordination
Maintain administrative records, schedules and reminders.
Take ownership of routine tasks and ensure deadlines are met.
Identify missing information and follow up with the appropriate colleagues.
Help improve existing administrative systems and processes.
What we are looking for
Experience with office administration and financial records, or a clear ability to learn these. Prior experience of Xero accounting software or a bookkeeping qualification is welcome but not essential.
Good general computer skills, particularly Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Word; confidence learning new software and online portals.
Care with figures and documents, discretion with confidential information and the ability to juggle deadlines.
An organised, helpful approach: you take initiative, ask when unsure and communicate clearly.
Any experience of Xero, bookkeeping, supplier questionnaires, CHAS or SafeContractor is an advantage, but we can explain our systems and procedures.
The scope of the role
This is an administration role, not a compliance-manager or finance-manager post. You will not be expected to write policies or decide technical answers. Our engineers, directors and accountants provide specialist input; your job is to organise, check, submit and follow up.
What we offer
Salary of £28,000–£36,000 per year, depending on experience.
25 days paid holiday, with additional unpaid leave by agreement.
Flexible start and finish times, subject to business requirements.
Private medical insurance and a workplace pension.
Mainly office-based in Tring, with hybrid or occasional home working available following initial induction and by agreement.
Practical training in Xero and our established financial and administrative processes.
Support for relevant development, including AAT qualifications if appropriate, introductory training on CHAS, SafeContractor and other supplier approval systems.
A friendly small-team environment in which your work has a visible impact.
Involvement in landmark projects such as the Forth Road Bridge, HMS Belfast, Battersea Power Station and the Temperate House at Kew Gardens.

Role: Protection Administrator
Location: Northampton (Hybrid)
Salary: £27,000 - £30,000

About the Company
A well-established financial services firm is seeking a detail-oriented Protection Administrator to join its growing team. The business specialises in providing expert mortgage and protection advice, helping clients safeguard their financial future through tailored solutions and outstanding service.
About the Role
This is a varied and rewarding role where you will work closely with clients, advisers, colleagues, and third-party providers to ensure the smooth administration of protection policies. You will play a key role in delivering excellent client service, maintaining accurate records, and supporting advisers throughout the application and policy lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
Act as the first point of contact for telephone and email enquiries from clients, advisers, and third parties.
Process and maintain protection policy documentation accurately and efficiently.
Support clients through the trust process, including completion of trust data capture forms.
Gather information and supporting documentation for protection fact-finds, liaising with the mortgage team to obtain current mortgage details where required.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records across internal systems and insurer platforms.
Provide timely updates to clients and the Senior Protection Adviser on applications, underwriting progress, and enquiries.
Assist with more complex protection cases and provide claims support when required.
Ensure all client records and regulated documentation are maintained accurately and compliantly.
Support reporting and administrative tasks to help the wider team achieve business objectives.
Skills & Experience
Previous experience within insurance, protection, financial services, or a similar administrative role.
Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
Professional written and verbal communication skills, with a confident and friendly telephone manner.
Excellent customer service skills and a commitment to delivering a positive client experience.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively to deadlines.
A proactive and collaborative approach to work.
Competent user of Microsoft Office and client management systems.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
What's on Offer
Hybrid working arrangement (once through probation)
26 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
Health Cash Plan.
Company pension scheme.
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
Clear opportunities for career progression.
Supportive and collaborative working environment.

Job title : Bells Motor Group Volvo Cars Bedford Level 2 Autocare Technician Apprenticeship Vacancy ID : 12987 Investor Group : Bells Site : Bells Bedford Postcode : MK41 0SF Recruitment Advisor : Donna Coulson Recruiter email : Hourly rate : 8 Specialism : Auto Care Level 2 Programme Name : Autocare Technician Standard (Level 2) Anticipated Interview Date : 2026-10-30 00:00:00 Anticipated start date : 2027-01-15 00:00:00 Employer description : Everything we do starts with people. Our purpose is to provide freedom to move, in a personal, sustainable and safe way. We are committed to simplifying our customers’ lives by offering better technology solutions that improve their impact on the world and bringing the most advanced mobility innovations to protect them, their loved ones and the people around them. Volvo Cars’ continued success is the result of a collaborative, diverse, and inclusive working environment. The people of Volvo Cars are committed to making a difference in our world. Today, we are one of the most well-known and respected car brands, with over 40,000 employees across the globe. We believe in bringing out the best in each other and harnessing the true power of people. At Volvo Cars your career is designed around your talents and aspirations so you can reach your full potential. Job description :
The Service department is vital to the success of our business. From right first-time fixes, to delivering excellent customer service, our Service Technicians/Mechanics play a pivotal role in delighting our customers and encouraging their continued loyalty.
Every day is different within the Service department. As a Service Technician/Mechanic apprentice, some of your duties will include:
Use of diagnostic equipment to identify vehicle faults.
Testing of parts and systems to ensure correct working.
Following checklists to ensure all critical parts of vehicles are examined.
Carrying out bumper to bumper overview, service, and inspection.
Maintenance of electronic systems including on- board entertainment systems.
Completion of legible and accurate paperwork for the customers and centres records
Maintenance of a clean and tidy work environment.
You will have the opportunity to work with a wide range of products including traditional, hybrid and electronic engines. From heritage vehicles to leading edge modern technology, our range will provide you with a varied technical training experience to build your skills as a Service Technician/Mechanic.
Training Provided
Training will be delivered using a combination of virtual classroom remote learning and face-to-face block release weeks at our state-of-the-art training centre.
Successful applicants must be prepared to travel to the Volvo Training and Development Centre, in Daventry, to complete their apprenticeship training. All training-related costs are fully covered as part of the programme, including travel, accommodation, and meals.
In the workplace, your personal, dedicated mentor will support your continued learning as you apply the skills and knowledge you have gained through the remote sessions and at the Volvo Training and Development Centre.
This is a fully rounded training experience where you will build life skills that last and gain both apprenticeship qualifications and brand certifications.
Qualifications received:
On successful completion of the apprenticeship programme, you will receive the following:
Level 2 Apprenticeship Standard in Autocare Technician
Certificate in Automotive Refrigerant Handling
Level 2 qualification for safe isolation of electric and hybrid vehicles
Progression towards Level 3 apprenticeship standard in Light Vehicle Maintenance and Repair
Future prospects
Once your apprenticeship is complete, you will continue your learning journey and you will have the opportunity drive your career forward. Some of our apprentices have gone on to become team leaders and managers within the retail network.

items.text:
Enjoy working with people and have a flair for sales? Join a friendly showroom team, help customers find the right tiles and earn uncapped commission.
Showroom Sales Advisor – Trade & Retail
Hitchin, SG4 0TW
Full time, permanent
Five-day working week, including weekends
Circa £27,000–£30,000
Achievable, uncapped commission
Training and overtime opportunities
Please Note: Applicants must be authorised to work in the UK.
Our client is a thriving wall and floor tile business with multiple retail outlets and more than three decades of industry experience. As one of the UK’s largest tile importers, it offers over 300 exclusive ranges for homes and businesses.
The business is known for its high-quality, affordable products, extensive selection and exceptional customer service.
The Role
As a Showroom Sales Advisor, you’ll welcome trade and retail customers, explore their requirements and help them find the perfect tiles and accessories for their projects.
You’ll showcase the product range, provide tailored advice and confidently guide customers towards informed purchasing decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Welcome customers and establish their individual project requirements
Showcase the extensive range of tiles and accessories
Provide friendly, knowledgeable and tailored product advice
Help customers make confident and informed purchasing decisions
Build positive relationships with trade and retail customers
Maintain a professional, enthusiastic and customer-focused approach
Complete tasks accurately, systematically and thoroughly
The Ideal Candidate
You’ll be a friendly, confident communicator who enjoys working with customers and thrives in a sales-focused environment.
Retail or showroom experience would be beneficial, but it is not essential, as comprehensive in-house training will be provided. Your enthusiasm, reliability and attitude are most important.
You will have:
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
A genuine passion for sales and customer service
A confident, positive and proactive attitude
Excellent reliability and punctuality
Good attention to detail
A methodical and organised approach
The flexibility to work weekends as part of a five-day week
Benefits
Competitive basic salary - circa £27,000–£30,000
Achievable, uncapped commission
Comprehensive in-house training
Overtime opportunities
Job security with an established and reputable business
The opportunity to develop your sales and product knowledge
How to Apply
If you’re ready to build your sales career with a successful and growing business, apply today.
After applying, please check your inbox for an email explaining how to tailor your application and provide any supporting information or documents.
Other Suitable Skills & Experience: Showroom Sales Advisor, Retail Sales Advisor, Trade Counter Sales, Sales Consultant, Customer Service Advisor, Tile Sales, Flooring Sales, Bathroom Showroom Sales, Kitchen Showroom Sales, Retail Assistant.

items.text:
Salary:
Competitive Salary + Bonus + Excellent Benefit s
Warehouse Operative x2 positions - (Part-Time) - Milton Keynes - Ideal Bathrooms
So, who are we? We are the Wolseley Group - a leading specialist trade merchant across the UK and Ireland. At Ideal Bathrooms, we pride ourselves on putting our people and customers at the heart of everything we do and providing opportunities to develop skills and build careers through our award-winning Wolseley Talent Guild.
Also, did we mention? In addition to the competitive salary, there are also benefits on tap including...
Annual leave (increasing with length of service), a generous pension scheme (matched up to 9%), potential to earn bonuses, enhanced maternity/adoption leave and access to a great range of online and high street discounts.
We also promote positive health and wellbeing by offering free access to healthcare, our popular YuLife app, our Cycle to Work scheme and more!
As a Warehouse Operative based in Milton Keynes , you'll play a key role in ensuring customer orders are picked, packed and dispatched accurately and efficiently. Working as part of a busy warehouse team, you'll help keep stock moving safely while delivering excellent service to our customers.
You'll be responsible for:
Picking, packing and loading customer orders accurately and safely
Moving and replenishing stock throughout the warehouse
Operating MHE equipment where trained and authorised
Maintaining high standards of housekeeping, health and safety
Supporting the wider warehouse team to ensure excellent customer service
These roles are part-time , working 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, evening shifts - 6pm-10pm .
And here's what we'd like you to have:
Previous warehouse experience would be highly preferred
MHE (Forklift) experience is advantageous
A positive attitude and willingness to learn new skills
Good attention to detail and a strong work ethic
The ability to work in a physically demanding role involving lifting, loading and regular walking
Enthusiastic, reliable and keen to develop, with the opportunity to gain in-house MHE licences, including VNA, Bendi and Pivot Steer, as part of the role
We look forward to receiving your application!

* = Pro rata for part time colleagues
What will you be doing?
As a Sales Assistant, you’ll be at the heart of the action — helping pet parents, supporting your teammates, and making every customer’s visit to our store a great experience. As with most retail roles, the working week involves being ‘on your feet’ and physically active* (e.g. putting stock out which can be heavy*) but tasks are rotated in store so you’ll get involved in a bit of everything as part of a team. Your day will include things like:
Offering genuinely friendly, helpful customer service (you’ll meet some fabulous humans and animals!)
Helping customers find what they need — and suggesting helpful extras that improve their pet’s wellbeing
Sharing advice to promote responsible pet ownership - we'll teach you what you need to know about different pets.
Keeping the store tidy, stocked and looking its best
Being part of a supportive, upbeat team that works (and laughs) together
* if you would require any reasonable adjustments for carrying out the role duties you can let us know on the application form. Let’s talk about upselling (the Jollyes way)! Yes, this is a sales role — but here’s how we do it:
We upsell suitable products to enhance customer experience, not to pressure anyone
It’s about suggesting the right treats, toys, food or accessories that genuinely help their pet live its best life
You’ll receive an induction to Jollyes with full training to build your confidence, product and pet care knowledge with a mix of manager led ‘on the job’ training and our online learning platform you can access to suit you.
Think of it as being a friendly knowledgeable guide for pet parents — not a pushy salesperson, that’s not us!
What do we need from you? We're looking for someone who shares our values and the following characteristics:
You'll be great at interacting with pets and people and have a fun, friendly personality.
Thrives in a fast-paced, hands-on retail environment and can achieve individual goals and team targets
Ideally, you will have experience in a similar, customer facing environment and have a hands-on approach.
Most of all, you must be able to offer the highest levels of customer service and be an ambassador for the Jollyes brand, sharing our values of being: Genuine, Wise, Focused, Eager, Together.
Flexibility on your availability is required as our opening hours include evenings and weekends when our stores can be busiest. Therefore you should be flexible to cover any shifts over our 7 day trading hours.
Can commit to a part time, permanent position – 20 hours per week
About Jollyes Pets Jollyes are an award-winning UK pet retailer with over 100 stores and over 50 years of pet expertise between our paws. Previous winners of the Retail Week award for ‘ Best Retailer ’ (under £250m t/o), and listed in the Sunday Times ‘ Best Places to Work ’, shortlisted for Happiest Place to Work , with excellent Trust Pilot reviews, you really can be sure you’re joining a great brand and employer, trusted by our customers and our colleagues. We are fully accredited as an age inclusive employer (Rest Less) and a proud member of the Pet Sustainability Coalition as well as supporting hundreds of local pet charities to make a difference in our communities. We welcome applicants of all ages (16+) - because passion for pets knows no age limit!
Ready to join the pack? If you're keen to develop your career in retail, work with a brilliant team and benefit from future progression as we continue to grow, you'll be warmly welcomed and your contribution truly valued. Click the 'apply' button today and join our pack as a Jollyes Sales Assistant!
