items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Payroll Administrator
Pay: £17,229.73 - £18,494.59 per year (part-time - 20-25hrs)
About Us
The Disability Resource Centre is an award-winning charity helping people affected by disability or long-term health conditions. We are an independent organisation and a registered charity that has disabled people at the centre of its decision making.
Our Vision
Empowering people of all ages who are affected by disability or health conditions to fulfil their potential and aspirations.
Our Mission
The Disability Resource Centre is here so that disabled people and their families have somewhere to turn if they feel alone and need help in any situation. We want all disabled people, those with long term health conditions and their carers to know that we are here to support them.
About The Role
We are looking for an accurate, organised and customer-focused Payroll Administrator to support our busy Direct Payments payroll service. You will help deliver timely and compliant payroll services for individual employers and Personal Assistants, while providing helpful support by telephone and email.
This is a varied role for someone who is confident managing end-to-end payroll tasks, maintaining clear records and working with employers, service users, HMRC and pension providers
Key responsibilities
Set up and maintain payroll records for employers, including HMRC registrations, employment information, pension arrangements and payroll files.
Accurately process weekly and monthly payroll data, including pay, tax, National Insurance, pensions, holiday pay, statutory payments, expenses and deductions.
Produce and distribute payslips and complete payroll year-end processes and statutory documentation.
Administer monthly pension contributions and payments through NEST, manage auto-enrolment requirements and submit pension declarations by statutory deadlines.
Prepare and submit HMRC documentation, including RTI submissions, reports and year-end returns.
Respond to payroll and finance-related telephone calls, emails and enquiries, providing guidance within agreed boundaries.
Maintain accurate records for audits and local authority reporting, and support payroll-related invoicing and payment monitoring.
Work closely with colleagues across Payroll, Direct Payments, Holding Accounts and Finance to maintain an accurate and responsive service.
About You
You will have:
At least two years' experience working in a busy payroll environment.
Experience of end-to-end payroll processing.
Working knowledge of HMRC regulations and payroll systems.
Strong accuracy, attention to detail and organisational skills.
Confidence using payroll and finance systems, Excel and digital filing tools.
A clear understanding of confidentiality and data protection.
The ability to manage your workload proactively and effectively within a part-time role.
A commitment to equality, inclusion and the rights of disabled people and carers.
Experience using BrightPay, Xero or NEST, working in a payroll bureau or Direct Payments environment, producing payroll or financial reports, or working in a charity or social enterprise would be desirable.
How To Apply
Please submit your CV together with a cover letter explaining why you are interested in the role and how your experience meets the requirements.
As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all. We particularly welcome applications from disabled people, those with long-term health conditions, and people with caring responsibilities.
If you meet the minimum essential criteria for the role and declare a disability, you will be offered a guaranteed interview under our inclusive recruitment policy.
Right to Work in the UK
Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Any offer of employment will be subject to appropriate right to work checks in line with current UK requirements.
Please note: We reserve the right to close this advertisement early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications, as we are keen to appoint as soon as possible.

£50,000
3on3off
Yolk Recruitment is proud to represent a leading organisation in Milton Keynes, in their search for a Multiskilled Maintenance Engineer.
Operating as part of a wider group, the company is a key player in the area. With a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence, the company continues to invest in its people, processes, and technology to maintain its position as an industry leader.

Position Overview:
As a Maintenance Engineer working a 3on3off shift you will be a crucial part of our client's operations. You will be responsible for maintaining and repairing a range of equipment, ensuring the smooth running of production processes, and contributing to the overall efficiency of the facility. If you're a skilled engineer looking for a challenging and rewarding role, this is your opportunity.
This is what you'll be doing.
Conducting both planned and reactive maintenance to minimise downtime and ensure the smooth running of production lines
Diagnosing and repairing mechanical and electrical faults in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
Ensuring all work complies with health and safety standards and food industry regulations
Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, optimising processes and enhancing efficiency

Previous experience in a maintenance engineering role within a fast paced manufacturing or food production environment
Strong electrical fault-finding and repair skills

Recognised Electrical Engineering Qualifications (NVQ, HNC, or equivalent)
Ability to work independently and as part of a team within a fast-paced setting
And this is what you'll get in return.
A salary of circa £50,000

The Opportunity
We are recruiting for an experienced Field Service Engineer to join a successful specialist machinery business operating across the UK. The company imports, distributes and services mechanical handling and processing machinery within the waste & recycling, construction and scrap metal sectors .
This is a varied field-based role working on excavators, shredders, crushers, conveyors and other heavy plant machinery . Extensive in-house training and genuine progression opportunities are available.
The Role
You will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, fault-finding and repairing heavy plant and processing machinery at customer sites throughout the UK. The role will involve planned and reactive maintenance, breakdown response, inspections, servicing and providing technical support to customers.
The Candidate
We are looking for someone with hands-on experience working on heavy plant, agricultural, construction, recycling, quarrying or similar machinery . Formal qualifications are not essential, with practical experience and strong mechanical fault-finding skills being the priority.

items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
Trainee Site Operative
Are you practical, motivated and looking to build a specialist career in a hands-on outdoor role? This is an excellent opportunity to join our team at Chiltern Thrust Bore and receive full training in trenchless technology, including horizontal directional drilling and guided auger boring, while working on projects across the UK and developing towards becoming a skilled Driller and Auger Bore Operator. Previous construction or civil engineering experience is not essential, making this an accessible opportunity for someone with technical aptitude, a positive attitude and a genuine willingness to learn.
FULL TRAINING PROVIDED
All levels of experience considered. Candidates do not necessarily need previous construction or civil engineering experience as full training will be provided. However, will require a technical aptitude and a willingness to learn new skills.
If you’ve also worked in the following roles, we’d also like to hear from you: Construction Operative, Trainee Construction Operative, Site Assistant, Construction Labourer, Site Labourer, Civils Operative, Drilling Operative, Assistant Driller, Drilling Assistant, Groundworker
SALARY: Starting from £33,800 per annum (£130 per day) + Career Development Opportunities
LOCATION: Olney, Buckinghamshire
This role will involve extensive UK travel with overnight stays . Additional remuneration when working away from home.
JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent
WORKING HOURS: Monday to Friday, 10 hours per day (However, there may be occasions when there is a potential to work overtime and specific projects requiring Night and/or Weekend working at additional rates)
PLEASE NOTE: Candidates will need a Driving Licence and their own vehicle to commute to the offices in Olney, Buckinghamshire. Company Transport will be provided when travelling to project sites nationwide.
** Opportunities to Train as a Skilled Driller and Auger Bore Operative **
JOB OVERVIEW
The company has an excellent opportunity for a Trainee Site Operative who enjoys practical, physical work and wants to learn a specialist trade. The company provides trenchless technology services to the construction and civil engineering sectors nationwide, using techniques including horizontal directional drilling and guided auger boring.
Working as the Trainee Site Operative you will travel throughout the UK with an experienced team, assisting across trenchless technology projects and learning directly from established lead drillers. The role offers both in-house and off-site training, provided and paid for by the company, with the aim of developing successful candidates into fully qualified drilling and Auger Bore Operators.
Previous construction-sector or directional drilling experience is advantageous but is not essential. As the Trainee Site Operative you will instead need a strong work ethic, technical aptitude, physical fitness and a willingness to learn while maintaining high standards of health and safety.
The role involves extensive UK travel. Some projects will require overnight stays away from home during the working week. Accommodation will be provided by the company together with an additional allowance and expenses when working away.
DUTIES
Your duties as the Trainee Site Operative include:
Supporting Trenchless Projects: Assist experienced team members with the delivery of trenchless technology services, including horizontal directional drilling, guided auger boring and associated site activities
Learning Specialist Techniques: Complete company-funded in-house and off-site training while developing the practical and technical skills required to progress towards becoming a skilled Driller and Auger Bore Operator
Assisting Lead Drillers: Work closely with lead drillers and other experienced colleagues, following instructions and supporting the safe and effective completion of project activities
Working Safely on Site: Follow safe working practices and maintain a high level of health and safety awareness to protect colleagues, contractors, members of the public and yourself
Supporting Nationwide Projects: Travel with the team from the Olney office to project locations across the UK, including staying away from home when required
Developing Technical Skills: Build knowledge of specialist equipment, working methods and trenchless technology through practical experience and structured training
Contributing to the Site Team: Take a positive, hands-on approach to physical site work and contribute effectively as a reliable member of the project team
CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS
ESSENTIAL
Full valid UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle to commute to the company’s offices in Olney, Buckinghamshire. Company transport is provided from the office to project sites nationwide
Willingness to travel extensively throughout the UK and stay away from home during the working week when projects require it
Flexibility to work nights or weekends when required
Positive, can-do attitude with a genuine willingness to learn new skills and develop a specialist trade
Technical aptitude and an interest in practical, hands-on work
Physical fitness suitable for an outdoor and physically active site-based role
Fluency in verbal and written English
Successful applicants must obtain a CSCS/CPCS card at their own expense if they do not already hold one
DESIRABLE
Previous experience within construction or a related environment
Experience or skills relating to directional drilling or guided auger boring
HGV Class 2 licence; however, this is advantageous only and this is not a driving role
NO AGENCIES PLEASE
HOW TO APPLY
To be considered for this job vacancy, please submit your CV to our Recruitment Team who will review your details.
JOB REF: AWDO-P15165
This job is being advertised by AWD online on behalf of Chiltern Thrust Bore
AWD-IN-SPJ

This vacancy is for a full-time position. Our promise to you - Competitive salary - 20 days' annual leave (full-time working) plus Bank Holidays - Pension scheme - Life insurance - On-the-job training and progression - Recognition scheme - Refer a friend - Flexible benefits, including high street savings, cycle to work scheme and Gymflex membership, and many more (where applicable) - Access to an Employee Assistance Programme and the Best Doctors Service via our Wellbeing Platform What will you be doing? - Ensuring different waste streams are segregated into the appropriate containers. - Assisting members of the public with separating their waste and providing general recycling advice. - Greeting members of the public and helping them to use the site effectively. - Ensuring waste is stored safely and in accordance with permit requirements. - Ensuring hazardous waste is separated and stored appropriately. - Keeping the site clean and tidy at all times. - Identifying contaminated recyclable materials and taking appropriate action. - Reporting Health and Safety incidents and near misses in accordance with company procedures. - Ensuring waste tickets, Waste Transfer Notes and Consignment Notes are completed correctly. - Working in accordance with FCC company policies, risk assessments and safe working practices. Electrical Assembly Technician
Permanent role
Based in Ampthill
Offering up to £40,000
Do you have an awareness of IPC-620 and J-STD-001 standards?
Do you have experience with Cables/Harnesses manufacturing?
Do you want to work with an industry-leading company?
If your answer to these is yes, then this could be the role for you!
As the Electrical Assembly Technician, you will be working alongside a market-leading Defence and Aerospace company who are constantly growing and developing. You will be involved in:
Assemble, terminate, and inspect cable harnesses, wiring looms, and electro-mechanical assemblies in accordance with engineering drawings and manufacturing specifications

Conduct in-process self-inspection and quality verification throughout assembly

Maintain full traceability and accurately complete all manufacturing and quality records
Identify non-conformances and support corrective action activities as required
Adhere to safe working practices and comply with all health, safety, and quality standards
Your skillset & experience:
Proven experience in cable harness assembly, wiring looms, or electro-mechanical assembly
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, wiring schedules, and build instructions
Hands-on experience with crimping, soldering, cable preparation, and connector assembly techniques
Awareness of IPC/WHMA-A-620 - Requirements and Acceptance for Cable and Wire Harness Assemblies
Awareness of J-STD-001 - Requirements for Soldered Electrical and Electronic Assemblies
Military and defence manufacturing standards

items.title: Plant Maintenance Technician (Night Shift)
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
You will join us as a night shift maintenance Technician. The role will ensure that day to day site operations are carried out in a safe, compliant and efficient manner in order to optimise the performance of the AD plant. Carrying out maintenance (planned and breakdowns), active involvement with the Planned Preventative Maintenance System.
Plant Maintenance Technician Requirements
The successful candidate will be an experienced, safety conscious individual with experience of mechanical or electrical engineer skills and ideally a relevant qualification. Work with and support the Site Manager in maximising cost effective and efficient output and continuously improving safety, health, environmental and operational standards and systems.
You will have the ability to adapt to changing circumstances and carry out practical hands on work. You will be used to materials handling, confined spaces and working at heights. To maintain and operate the AD plant as instructed in a safe and efficient manner; assist with overall housekeeping and cleaning and carrying out data collection, analysis and reporting
Training to obtain a telehandler licence will be provide, if you do not already hold one. A full driving licence is required. The role follows a Tuesday-to-Friday night shift pattern, working from 19:30 to 06:00. Overtime is paid for approved additional hours worked.
The successful candidate will work day shifts during the initial training and induction period, which is anticipated to last approximately two to three months. You will then transition to the contracted night shift pattern, subject to satisfactory completion of the required training.
About Biogen (UK) Ltd
Biogen is the UK’s leader in anaerobic digestion (AD) and one of the largest independent AD operators in the UK. Having expanded its food waste recycling network through acquisition, it has a combined network of nineteen AD plants located across England, Scotland and Wales that provide cost-effective, low carbon, food and organic waste management solutions. Working with supermarkets, the hospitality industry, food manufacturers and local authorities across the UK, the AD sites recycle over half a million tonnes of food waste each year.
Location: Biogen Westwood, Bedford Road, Rushden, NN10 0SQ
Job Type: Full time, permanent, night shift 40 hours per week
Salary: up to £32,000 pa depending on experience+ 20% Night shift allowance
Benefits: 6.6 weeks holiday 4% employer pension and x4 life assurance
You may have experience of the following: Plant Technician, Maintenance Technician, Plant Engineer, Maintenance Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Mechanical Engineer, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, Plant Maintenance Engineer, AD, Anaerobic Digestion, Site Technician, etc.

items.title: Dual Fuel SMART Meter Installer - Northamptonshire
items.apply_route: Apply on Reed (free account) or the employer's site
items.text:
We're looking for Dual Fuel SMART Meter Installers to join our growing team across the Northamptonshire area. If you enjoy working independently, meeting new people, solving problems and making a real difference for customers every day, this could be the perfect opportunity. With plenty of variety, flexibility and the chance to play your part in the energy transition, there's never been a better time to join us.
What's in it for you?
Competitive base salary of £40,532 , reviewed annually.
Quarterly performance-based bonus through our Field Incentive Scheme, with the opportunity to earn up to £4,800 per year .
Career development opportunities, including the potential to train and become qualified in 3-phase meter installation .
Everything you need to succeed from day one, including a branded van and fuel card, smartphone, tablet, body-worn camera, uniform, PPE and all the tools you'll need.
Here's a taste of what you'll be doing
You'll visit customers in their homes, supporting those who may be struggling with their energy bills by providing tailored advice and, where appropriate, installing SMART Pay As You Go (PAYG) meters to help them take control of their energy use. You'll also investigate reports of meter tampering, ensuring installations are safe and secure.
This role offers the flexibility to support your work-life balance, as long as you meet your weekly working hours.
Delivering excellent face-to-face customer service.
Working with customers to discuss and agree suitable payment solutions.
Exchanging meters to SMART Pay As You Go (PAYG) or classic prepayment meters.
Leading warrant teams, where required, to safely disconnect meters.
Planning efficient daily routes to help reduce your carbon footprint.
Uploading job information securely, including body-worn video footage (with a monthly broadband & electric allowance provided).
Are we a match? We're looking for someone with:
MOCOPA/CMA1/MET2 qualifications.
A home base in or within easy travelling distance of the Northamptonshire area.
A full UK or EU driving licence (up to 6 points accepted).
Strong customer service and communication skills.
The confidence to work independently in the field.
A willingness to undertake 3-phase electricity training, including travel and overnight stays where required.
Access to broadband at home.
Here's what else you need to know
This is a permanent role.
Your role also includes monthly £10 electric and broadband allowances.
This role can close at any time.
The start date for this role will be 2027.
Excellent parental leave allowance.
Award-Winning Workplace - We're proud to be named a Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025 and the Best Place to Work for 16-34-year-olds
Outstanding Benefits - Enjoy 26 days of annual leave plus bank holidays, a generous pension, life cover, bonus opportunities and access to 20 flexible benefits with tax/NI savings
Flexible & Family-Friendly - Our industry-leading hybrid and family-friendly policies earned us double recognition at the Personnel Today Awards 2024 . We're open to discussing how flexibility can work for you
Inclusive & Diverse - We're the only energy company in the Inclusive Top 50 UK Employers . We're also proud winners of Best Employer for Women and Human Company of the Year -recognising our inclusive, people-first culture
Support at Every Stage of Life - We're Fertility Friendly and Menopause Friendly accredited, with inclusive support for everyone
Accessible & Supportive - Do you consider yourself as having a disability? As a Disability Confident Employer, we guarantee interviews for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role and will make any adjustments needed during the process
Invested in Your Growth - From inclusive talent networks to top-tier development programmes, we'll support your growth every step of the way
For all successful candidates. Due to the nature of this role your employment will be subject to a basic DBS (Disclosure Barring Service) check being carried out by ourselves via a 3rd party service provider
